aviation.t: 航空专家详细分析了统计数据。

statistics.s: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.
statistics.t: 航空专家详细分析了统计数据。

statistics.s: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
statistics.t: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。

logically.s: An argument may be logically sound without being true.
logically.t: 不正确的命题听起来可能符合逻辑。

onlooker.s: This onlooker almost got in the way of the fire truck.
onlooker.t: 这个看热闹的人差点把消防车的路挡住了。

resource.s: The one resource more precious than any other was land.
resource.t: 唯一比无论什么资源都珍贵的是土地。

resource.s: The only thing that is more precious than any resource is land.
resource.t: 唯一比什么资源都珍贵的是土地。

pollute.s: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
pollute.t: 我们应该尽力不要污染环境。

myth.s: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
myth.t: 神话让我们能透悉古文明。
保罗的成功是一个神话。

endlessly.s: If you keep on endlessly complaining, I will get angry.
endlessly.t: 如果你继续没完没了的抱怨，我就生气了。

endlessly.s: I'm getting endlessly annoyed by this foolishness.
endlessly.t: 我对这种愚蠢的行为表示非常的气愤。

lastly.s: Lastly, is there anything else to share with the group?
lastly.t: 最后，还有其他要和大家分享的吗？

script.s: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
script.t: 总的来说，这部电影从剧本到银幕是成功的。

dodge.s: Don't dodge the issue, I want you to answer my question.
dodge.t: 不要逃避，我要你回答我的问题。

punctuation.s: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
punctuation.t: 你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。

punctuation.s: An exclamation mark is a punctuation mark.

edition.s: Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
edition.t: 第一还是第二的版本比较齐全？

edition.s: I found the rare edition that I've been looking so long for.
edition.t: 找到了寻找已久的珍本。

edition.s: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
edition.t: 最近这个品牌推出了一系列限量版内衣。

tick.s: I like to take things apart to see what makes them tick.
tick.t: 我喜欢把东西拆开，看看里面的结构。

pro.s: The photos are taken by a pro, so they'll turn out well.
pro.t: 照片是专业摄影师拍的，所以不会有问题。

pro.s: No pro golfer in Japan is as popular as Jumbo Ozaki.
pro.t: 尾崎将司是日本最受欢迎的专业高尔夫球手。

flow.s: Though tears may flow down your face, I won't look back.
flow.t: 任凭眼泪在你脸上滑过，我头也不回。

flow.s: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
flow.t: 移民川流不息地进入这个国家。

flow.s: The flow of the water was strong enough to wash away the bridge.
flow.t: 水流的强力把桥给冲垮了。

bustling.s: Algiers is a bustling city of over three million people.
bustling.t: 阿尔及尔是一座有着超过三百多万人口的繁华都市。

corporate.s: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
corporate.t: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。

earnings.s: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
earnings.t: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。

charity.s: It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
charity.t: 世界需要的是公正，不是施舍。

charity.s: Tom regularly donates money to charity.
Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
charity.t: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

lifeguard.s: I applied for a job as a lifeguard at the community pool.
lifeguard.t: 我去了公共游泳池应征当救生员。

employ.s: His age didn't enter into our decision not to employ him.
employ.t: 我们决定不录用他时，并没有考虑他的年龄问题。

offspring.s: The atomic bomb is the offspring of 20th century physics.
offspring.t: 原子弹是二十世纪物理学的产物。

industrialization.s: Industrialization often goes hand in hand with pollution.
industrialization.t: 工业化常会导致环境污染。

unconscious.s: He was discovered unconscious on the floor of the kitchen.
unconscious.t: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

birthplace.s: He told me his age, his birthplace, his family, and so on.
birthplace.t: 他告诉了我他的年龄、出生地、家庭，等等。

nap.s: A little nap and, just like that, I'm as fresh as a daisy.
nap.t: 我小睡后就感到生龙活虎。

nap.s: Sorry, I was taking a nap and didn't hear you ring the doorbell.
nap.t: 对不起，我在睡午觉，没听到你按门铃。

nap.s: Tom says he needs a nap.

daisy.s: A little nap and, just like that, I'm as fresh as a daisy.
daisy.t: 我小睡后就感到生龙活虎。

initial.s: Your initial order is subject to a special discount of 5%.
initial.t: 首次订购可获九五折的特别优惠。

vibrate.s: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
vibrate.t: 飞机开始震动的时候，乘客们都紧张了起来。

apathetic.s: It is said that the younger generation today is apathetic.
apathetic.t: 有人说新一代的人很冷漠。

remittance.s: I'm sorry, without an I.D. you cannot receive a remittance.
remittance.t: 对不起，没有身份证是不能领汇款的。

gulp.s: He raised the glass to his lips and drained it at one gulp.
gulp.t: 他把杯子举到嘴边，一饮而尽。

gulp.s: Gulp! The food is delicious, but I'm afraid of how expensive it's going to be.
gulp.t: 咕噜！这食物太好吃了，但我担心它会很贵。

endeavour.s: We will endeavour to finish the job by the end of the week.
endeavour.t: 我们会尽力在这礼拜结束前把工作完成。

creep.s: Sometimes it's fun to creep yourself out thinking about it.
creep.t: 偶尔偷偷地去想这个问题，还是很有意思的。

physically.s: Generally speaking, men are physically stronger than women.
physically.t: 一般说来，男生的肌肉比女生发达。

physically.s: Tom was there physically, but not mentally.

luxury.s: On the seventh floor, you can find four luxury restaurants.
luxury.t: 在七楼，你可以找到四个豪华餐厅。

luxury.s: In the United States the automobile is a necessity and not a luxury.
luxury.t: 在美国，汽车并不是奢华的象征，而是生活的必需品。

closet.s: They both agreed to come out of the closet to their family.
closet.t: 他们约好一起向家人出柜。

closet.s: For many gay men, coming out of the closet is a difficult experience.
closet.t: 对许多男同性恋者来说，出柜是一个困难的经历。

feckless.s: Our feckless opposition party didn't do enough to stop him.
feckless.t: 我们软弱的反对派不足以阻止他。

suburb.s: The other day something horrible happened in a Tokyo suburb.
suburb.t: 前几天，东京郊外发生了件可怕的事情。

suburb.s: Helen and Kathy rented an apartment in a suburb of Tokyo.
suburb.t: 海伦和凯蒂在东京郊区租了个套间。

host.s: A guest should not try to make himself superior to the host.
The party host had a Portuguese accent.
host.t: 派对主席说话时有葡萄牙腔

superfluous.s: There was always too much superfluous writing in his essays.
superfluous.t: 在他的文章中总是有太多肤浅的桥段。

shrine.s: On New Year's Day many Japanese go to the shrine to worship.
shrine.t: 很多日本人都会在元旦到神社参拜。

shrine.s: The decay of the shrine is due, in part, to acid rain.
shrine.t: 庙宇的毁坏有一部分要归因于酸雨。

comply.s: Hopefully you'll comply with traffic regulations after this.
comply.t: 希望你们以后严格遵守交通规则。

comply.s: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
comply.t: 一些海滩没能遵守环保规定。

transition.s: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
transition.t: 由硬体到软体的转变是缓慢的。

accustom.s: You have to accustom yourself to the crowded trains in Tokyo.
accustom.t: 你要习惯东京拥挤的火车。

disastrous.s: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
disastrous.t: 环境污染可以对一个区域的生态造成极大的影响。

altering.s: He's proposing a suggestion for altering the research method.
altering.t: 他提出改革研究方法的意见。

fig.s: It's too bad the college dining hall doesn't have fig cookies.
fig.t: 可惜大学食堂没有无花果饼干。

fig.s: I made a petition for there to be fig cookies in the university restaurants. Do you want to sign it?
fig.t: 我弄了一份请愿书要求在大学食堂提供无花果饼干，你们愿意签名吗？

defense.s: The defense of the master thesis is just happening next month.
defense.t: 下个月就要进行硕士论文答辩了。

defense.s: Attack is the best form of defense.

aging.s: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
aging.t: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

publish.s: He has written a book, however, he has no money to publish it.
publish.t: 他写了一本书，但是没有钱出版。

voluntary.s: She can only go to the company to do voluntary work on Sundays.
voluntary.t: 她星期天也只能去公司做义务劳动了。

ethical.s: It needs to be judged on whether it meets the ethical standards.
ethical.t: 必须判断一个行为是否符合道德标准。

ethical.s: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
ethical.t: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

depressed.s: I feel depressed because there are a lot of things I have to do.
depressed.t: 因为有一堆事情得做，我感到绝望。

reactor.s: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
reactor.t: 原子反应堆发出大量的热能。

thermal.s: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
thermal.t: 原子反应堆发出大量的热能。

hilarious.s: The laser cow in WHAT THE CAR? is both hilarious and terrifying!
hilarious.t: 《WHATTHECAR?》中的雷射奶牛又好笑又吓人！

hilarious.s: I try not to laugh at my own jokes, but we all know I'm hilarious.
hilarious.t: 我尽量不对我自己的笑话发笑，但是我们都知道我很搞笑。

obscene.s: One must be respectful when speaking, and not say obscene things.
obscene.t: 开口要有礼貌，不讲下流话。

intransitive.s: A complete intransitive verb takes neither complement nor object.
intransitive.t: 一个完完全全的不及物动词既没有补语，又没有宾语。

complement.s: A complete intransitive verb takes neither complement nor object.
complement.t: 一个完完全全的不及物动词既没有补语，又没有宾语。

ownership.s: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
ownership.t: 管理一间公司和拥有一间公司是不能相提并论的两回事。

par.s: Some analysts consider Somalia as the failed state par excellence.
par.t: 一些分析家认为索马里是非常失败的国家。

kerosene.s: In places where it snows a lot, kerosene is an indispensable item.
kerosene.t: 在下雪很多的地方，煤油是不可或缺的东西。

phonograph.s: Compact discs have entirely taken the place of phonograph records.
phonograph.t: CD已经完全取代了胶木唱片。

biscuit.s: "Mum, can I have a biscuit?" "No, you shouldn't eat between meals."
biscuit.t: "妈妈，我能吃一块饼干吗？""不行，不该在3餐间吃。"

champion.s: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
champion.t: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

champion.s: There can only be one world champion. The question is: Who will it be?
champion.t: 只有一个人能成为世界冠军。问题是：会是谁呢？

poke.s: It's best if you don't poke your nose into other people's business.
poke.t: 你最好不要插手别人的事务。

scrupulous.s: You can see that the architect paid scrupulous attention to detail.
scrupulous.t: 这位建筑师显然是一位无微不至的建筑师。

intent.s: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
intent.t: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。

barn.s: When the heater in the barn fails, you get milk-flavoured ice cubes.
barn.t: 当牛舍的暖气坏了,你就会有牛奶味的冰块。

barn.s: We took refuge from the storm in a nearby barn.
barn.t: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。

inquire.s: She had the courage to go and inquire about the results of the exam.
inquire.t: 她有勇气去查询考试的结果。

selfless.s: I am a selfish person, but I became very selfless after meeting you.
selfless.t: 我是个很自私的人，但是遇到你之后变得特别地无私。

curt.s: Don't you think it's rude to give people such a curt reply like that?
curt.t: 你回答得这么简短，不觉得有点没礼貌吗？

contradiction.s: From what stems this contradiction between our hopes and our reality?
contradiction.t: 希望与现实之间的矛盾，因何而起？

eye-opener.s: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.
eye-opener.t: 这部有关环境危机的纪录片真是令人大开眼界。

flick.s: Notice how the hero in an action flick never seems to run out of ammo?
flick.t: 你有没有发现动作片主角的子弹好像永远都不会用完？

disrupt.s: Don't eat too much and disrupt the stomach's normal digestion process.
disrupt.t: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

infrared.s: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
infrared.t: 人会因为体温而在红外线摄影机上显现。

patriotism.s: Does any other country fan the flames of patriotism as much as America?
patriotism.t: 有没有一个国家比美国更提倡爱国主义？

viewpoint.s: It's the first time I've heard that kind of viewpoint; it's comforting.
viewpoint.t: 第一次听到这样的观点，很宽慰。

tiresome.s: If your children are being tiresome, you will feel time passing slowly.
tiresome.t: 如果你的孩子很辛苦你觉得日子很漫长。

bake.s: I haven't baked bread in a long time. How about we bake a little today?
bake.t: 我有好久都没烤面包了。要不今天烤点儿？

resentment.s: Losing your temper for no reason would invite the resentment of others.
resentment.t: 无理由乱发脾气会让别人反感。

swept.s: The manager ordered all the rooms to be swept clean as soon as possible.
swept.t: 经理命令要把所有房间尽快打扫干净。

swept.t: 冷空气疾风席卷整栋房子。

repudiate.s: My parents would repudiate my brother if they ever found out he was gay.
repudiate.t: 如果我父母发现我的弟弟是同性恋的话，他们不会认他的。

sparkle.s: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.
sparkle.t: 我数著星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。

foretell.s: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.
foretell.t: 我数著星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。

debacle.s: Had I but known what she intended, I might have forestalled this debacle.
debacle.t: 如果我了解了他的意图，我可能就能避免这场灾难。

debacle.s: What was at first a natural disaster rapidly became a man-made debacle.
debacle.t: 起初的天灾迅速演变为了人祸。

autonomous.s: The private colleges and universities of the United States are autonomous.
autonomous.t: 美国的私立学院和私立大学是自给自足的。

atm.s: It doesn't matter if you have no money left in your pocket. Go to the ATM.
atm.t: 口袋里的钱摸空了没关系，去找自动取款机吧。

unbearably.s: Parts of the world that are already hot enough might become unbearably so.
unbearably.t: 世界上已经够热的地方会变得让人无法忍受。

reproducible.s: Does the error occur regularly or sporadically? Is the error reproducible?
reproducible.t: 错误是经常出现还是偶尔出现？错误是否能够模仿？

parent.s: A parent or teacher should bring home to children the pleasure of reading.
parent.t: 家长或老师应该让孩子们享受阅读的乐趣。

willingly.s: A true German can't stand the French, yet willingly he drinks their wines.
willingly.t: 一个真正的德国人无法忍受法国人，但他很愿意喝他们的酒。

willingly.s: I willingly join the Chinese Communist Party.
willingly.t: 我自愿加入中国共产党。

willingly.s: Tom will never willingly go there by himself.
willingly.t: 汤姆绝不愿意独自去那里。

database.s: Just because it's in Tatoeba.org's database, doesn't mean it's a sentence.
database.t: 在Tatoeba.org的数据库里并不意味着它是一个句子。

database.s: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
database.t: 我们优化了数据库索引，结果系统效率提高了50%。

appreciation.s: He always comes to show his appreciation during the New Year and holidays.
appreciation.t: 过年过节时，他总是来慰劳。

oncoming.s: He failed to see the stop sign at the intersection and hit an oncoming car.
oncoming.t: 他没有看见十字路口的停止标志，和一辆迎面而来的汽车撞个正著。

apathy.s: Coldness sometimes don't mean apathy. It's just a tool to avoid being hurt.
apathy.t: 冷漠，有时候并不是无情，只是一种逃避被伤害的工具！

apathy.s: Nothing is more sad than stupidity and apathy.

trace.s: Miss Wang has a trace of obstinacy in her, but she is still a good student.
trace.t: 王小姐有一点固执，但是她还算是一个好学生。

trace.s: There is a trace on the table.

trace.t: 他没有留下痕迹就消失了。

percentage.s: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
percentage.t: 你觉得绕路的司机占所有的出租车司机的百分之多少？

violence.s: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
violence.t: 靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。

violence.s: Violence is the cancer of our society.

tantamount.s: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
tantamount.t: 靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。

momentary.s: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
momentary.t: 靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。

cop.s: My boss tried to cop a feel but I slapped his hand before he got any further.
cop.t: 我老板想占我便宜，我便一掌拍了在他的手上，让他不能再毛手毛脚。

cop.s: It seems that the policeman in this TV series is a dirty cop who abuses his authority.
cop.t: 这套电视剧里的惊察似乎是个滥用职权的坏蛋。

pickpocket.s: Some brave passengers caught the pickpocket and turned him over to the police.
pickpocket.t: 几位见义勇为的乘客把小偷抓住了，还把他送到了警方的手中。

brass.s: We've been horsing around too much; it's high time we got down to brass tacks.
brass.t: 我们胡闹太久了,现在该是我们考虑基本事实的时候了。

brass.s: Gold is similar in color to brass.
brass.t: 金的颜色和黄铜很相似。

brass.s: A brass band is marching along the street.
brass.t: 一个管弦乐团沿着路前进

ideology.s: The heart of Esperanto ideology is the equality of all languages and cultures.
ideology.t: 世界语的思想核心在于一切语言文化的平等。

ideology.s: This is the ideology to which my speech is written.
ideology.t: 我的演讲稿就是依据这个理论写的。

halt.s: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
halt.t: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。

nonetheless.s: Carrefour's Ham offcuts are not expensive at all, but are nonetheless delicious.
nonetheless.t: 家乐福的火腿剩料一点都不贵，然而却很好吃。

elaborate.s: In this album all the sounds that you hear are really elaborate computer voices.
elaborate.t: 在这张专辑里,所有你听到的声音都是用电脑精密制作出的声音。

elaborate.s: She made elaborate preparations for the party.
elaborate.t: 她精心筹备了这个派对。

alien.s: If we ever came in contact with an alien race, how would we communicate with it?
alien.t: 如果有天我们真的和外星人有了接触，我们应该怎样和他们沟通呢？

alien.s: I swear, I saw an alien!
alien.t: 我发誓我看到了外星人。

sanction.s: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
sanction.t: 必须获得有关当局的批准才能进入这座建筑物。

ingredient.s: Cookies may contain nuts or peanuts, even if not included in the ingredient list.
ingredient.t: 虽然配料表中未列出坚果和花生，但饼干中仍可能含有这些成分。。

destruction.s: Nowadays it's not possible to protect oneself against weapons of mass destruction.
destruction.t: 如今要保护自己不受大规模杀伤性武器的伤害是不可能的。

destruction.s: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
destruction.t: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。

rescue.s: The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.
rescue.t: 救助人员将为地震受灾者提供资助。

rescue.s: I'm going to help you rescue Tom.

enquire.s: I am going to enquire at the service desk if there are any restaurants around here.
enquire.t: 我要去柜台打听这里附近有没有餐厅。

temporarily.s: This kind of medicine can temporarily alleviate pain. If you need it, just take it.
temporarily.t: 这种药可以暂时缓解身体的疼痛，你需要的话就拿去吧。

alleviate.s: This kind of medicine can temporarily alleviate pain. If you need it, just take it.
alleviate.t: 这种药可以暂时缓解身体的疼痛，你需要的话就拿去吧。

alleviate.s: When I have migraines, aspirin doesn't alleviate the pain for me.
alleviate.t: 当我偏头痛的时候，阿司匹林减缓不了我的痛苦。

alleviate.s: In order to alleviate employment pressures, the nation has established a series of relevant policies.
alleviate.t: 为了缓解就业压力，国家已经制定了一系列相关政策。

consultative.s: The abbreviation of "Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference" is "CPPCC".
consultative.t: “中国人民政治协商会议”的简称是“人民政协”。

underdeveloped.s: This area is still underdeveloped because of a lack of interest from the government.
underdeveloped.t: 因为缺乏的政府的关注，这个区域还不发达。

refine.s: Good day, lords. In what way can I refine upon my adroitness in aural comprehension?
refine.t: 早安，师傅。我应该怎么样提高听力能力？

aural.s: Good day, lords. In what way can I refine upon my adroitness in aural comprehension?
aural.t: 早安，师傅。我应该怎么样提高听力能力？

blurt.s: It was the sort of weird car that made me want to blurt out, "what the heck is that?"
blurt.t: 这辆有点怪的车让我脱口而出"那是什么鬼东西啊?"

heck.s: It was the sort of weird car that made me want to blurt out, "what the heck is that?"
heck.t: 这辆有点怪的车让我脱口而出"那是什么鬼东西啊?"

impeccable.s: He has impeccable manners, which means you can never be sure what he actually thinks!
impeccable.t: 他是一个极有礼貌的人﹣也就是说，他内心的想法永远没有人能看得穿！

wrestling.s: As I entered the café, I found two young men watching a wrestling match on television.
wrestling.t: 我步进咖啡室，看见两个年轻人正在电视上看摔角比赛。

formerly.s: Formerly people did not know that the earth is round and that it moves around the sun.
formerly.t: 以前的人不知道地球是圆的，也不知道地球是绕著太阳转的。

formerly.s: Formerly this building was a hospital.

interact.s: You should interact with the local culture more, to better understand some traditions.
interact.t: 你应该多接触本文化，多了解一些传统习俗。

instruction.s: From reading good books we can derive pleasure, friendship, experience and instruction.
instruction.t: 读书，可以获得乐趣、友谊、经验和指导。

goalkeeper.s: When the goalkeeper touched the ball, the referee awarded the other team a corner kick.
goalkeeper.t: 守门员用手碰到了球，裁判给了对方一个角球。

goalkeeper.s: The goalkeeper for France dived to the ground and saved Ronaldo’s shot.
goalkeeper.t: 法国队守门员扑到地上截住了罗纳尔多的射门。

goalkeeper.s: England’s goalkeeper was criticized for the amount of goals he conceded.
goalkeeper.t: 英格兰的守门员因为自己失球过多而被批评。

referee.s: When the goalkeeper touched the ball, the referee awarded the other team a corner kick.
referee.t: 守门员用手碰到了球，裁判给了对方一个角球。

referee.s: They seemed to offend the referee.
The referee blew the whistle and called a hand ball on him.
referee.t: 裁判吹响了口哨，判定他手球。

morality.s: Gentleness and cheerfulness, these come before all morality; they are the perfect duties.
morality.t: 良善和喜乐比道德更加重要，是我们所应尽的绝对义务。

consumer.s: Not being able to carry out payments on time can cause very large losses for the consumer.
consumer.t: 不能按时交付货款的话会给客户带来很大损失。

punish.s: "Teacher, would you punish me for something I didn't do?" "No." "I didn't do my homework."
punish.t: "老师，你会为了我没做的事情而罚我吗？“”不会。“”我没做作业。“

punish.s: Punish the wicked and save the weak.

organizational.s: In the previous meeting, we already discussed the organizational problem within our company.
organizational.t: 在上次会议中我们已经讨论了我们集团的组织问题。

narrow.s: An expert is a person who has made all the mistakes that can be made in a very narrow field.
narrow.t: 专家就是一个能够把所有的错误控制在最小范围内的人。

narrow.s: The angle would be too narrow.
The road is too narrow for cars.
narrow.t: 这条路对汽车来说太窄了。

rote.s: You should use words to make sentences, rather than try to learn them with rote memorisation.
rote.t: 你应该宁可用词汇来造句，也不要试着死记硬背。

economically.s: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
economically.t: 越来越多的女人拥有自己的事业并实现和丈夫的经济独立。

frustrating.s: It's very frustrating to try to find your glasses when you can't see anything without glasses.
frustrating.t: 当我们没有眼镜什么都看不见却要试着找回眼镜的时候很让人灰心。

quantities.s: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
quantities.t: 进口数量的急速增长让我们感到惊讶。

spout.s: At first I thought the development board was up the spout, but it was just a loose connection.
spout.t: 本来以为是开发板给我弄坏了，原来是电源线接触不良。

courtyard.s: In Beijing, hutongs are alleys formed by lines of siheyuans, the traditional courtyard residences.
courtyard.t: 在北京，胡同是由四合院的传统居所排形成。

suitor.s: Unsure of which suitor she wanted to marry, the princess vacillated, saying now one, now the other.
suitor.t: 因为不知道想跟哪个追求者结婚，公主犹豫了，一会儿指定这个，一会儿指定那个。

hitherto.s: Karl Marx says, "The history of all hitherto existing societies is the history of class struggles."
hitherto.t: 卡尔·马克思说：“到目前为止的一切社会的历史都是阶级斗争的历史。”

petition.s: I made a petition for there to be fig cookies in the university restaurants. Do you want to sign it?
petition.t: 我弄了一份请愿书要求在大学食堂提供无花果饼干，你们愿意签名吗？

motivation.s: When real life friends desert us, books are always ready to offer friendship, sympathy and motivation.
motivation.t: 生活中的朋友弃我们不顾之时，书随时给我们送来友谊、同情和鼓励。

genuinely.s: In fact, love is the only genuinely precious thing in life; it's also the only thing worthy of pursuit.
genuinely.t: 其实爱情是人生唯一的、真正珍贵的;也是唯一的、真正值得追求的东西。

paste.s: Country girls like to cut red paper into peach and plum blossoms and paste them onto doors and windows.
paste.t: 农村的女孩喜欢把红色的纸裁减成桃和李的花及贴在门窗上。

paste.s: I could eat some beef noodle soup, or some reheated rice with soybean paste like that, no problem.
paste.t: 我可以不慌不忙吃牛奶面包鸡蛋，或者泡饭酱菜。

thankfully.s: If your friend reminds you kindly of your faults, take what he says not only pleasantly, but thankfully.
thankfully.t: 如果有朋友对你作出善意批评，你不止应该欣然接受，还要好好的感谢他。
幸好没有发生什么不愉快的事。

thankfully.s: Thankfully, there was an Armani store just outside the alley where Dima had slept.
thankfully.t: 幸好，在狄马睡觉的小巷外面，刚好有一家阿玛尼。

lousy.s: That's the thing about people who think they hate computers. What they really hate is lousy programmers.
lousy.t: 那些自认为讨厌电脑的人就是这么回事。他们真正讨厌的是差劲的程序员。

officially.s: The Japanese Parliament today officially elected Ryūtarō Hashimoto as the country's 52nd prime minister.
officially.t: 日本国会今天正式选举了桥本龙太郎作为全国第52届总理。

officially.s: This person's worldview is officially unhealthy.

tar.s: The Japanese Parliament today officially elected Ryūtarō Hashimoto as the country's 52nd prime minister.
tar.t: 日本国会今天正式选举了桥本龙太郎作为全国第52届总理。

self-contradictory.s: For example, if a chain-smoking teacher cautions a pupil for smoking, that warning is self-contradictory.
self-contradictory.t: 举例说，如果一个老师警告学生不要吸烟，但自己却每天吸个不停，那么这个警告就是自相矛盾的了。

generalise.s: I don't think that it is possible to generalise about a whole nation and say how all Japanese people are.
generalise.t: 我觉得不可以泛化一个民族，说日本人怎么样。

impartial.s: He puts on a show of being impartial and unbiased, but I think he's just a guy with no opinion of his own.
impartial.t: 他总在别人面前装出大公无私的样子，但依我看，他只不过是个没有主见的家伙。

unbiased.s: He puts on a show of being impartial and unbiased, but I think he's just a guy with no opinion of his own.
unbiased.t: 他总在别人面前装出大公无私的样子，但依我看，他只不过是个没有主见的家伙。

bleak.s: I guess my view on friendship is pretty bleak because I've never really had to rely on anyone for anything.
bleak.t: 我假设我对友谊的看法十分灰暗，因为我从来没有真正为了什么事靠过什么人。

guard.s: As everyone stood guard silently, someone ran to the corner of the street and called over a police officer.
guard.t: 默默守护中，有人跑到街头，叫来了协警。

organic.s: Some people only buy organic food; they think that in this way their body will not be damaged by pollutants.
organic.t: 一些人只买有机的食物，他们认为这样可以使他们的健康不受污染的损害。

organic.s: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
organic.t: 汤姆和玛丽拥有一个小型的有机农场。

pollutants.s: Some people only buy organic food; they think that in this way their body will not be damaged by pollutants.
pollutants.t: 一些人只买有机的食物，他们认为这样可以使他们的健康不受污染的损害。

option.s: In the U.S., you have the option, when you enter a restaurant, to sit in the smoking or non-smoking section.
option.t: 在美国，当你进入餐厅时，你可选择坐在吸烟区或是禁烟区。

increasingly.s: Over the past ten years, people have become increasingly aware that they need to change their eating habits.
increasingly.t: 十年来，人们越来越强烈地意识到需要改变自己的饮食习惯。

increasingly.s: In England, parks taking rare breeds of animals as their theme are becoming increasingly popular with people.
increasingly.t: 在英国，以珍稀物种为主题的公园变得越来越受人们的欢迎。

decoration.s: This house is nearby, it has two bedrooms and a living room, and the decoration isn't bad; it's 1500 a month.
decoration.t: 这房子在附近，两室一厅，装修也不错，一个月1500。

decoration.s: Their siheyuans were far smaller in scale and simpler in design and decoration, and the hutongs were narrower.
decoration.t: 他们的四合院要小得多，设计和装饰也比较简单，胡同也比较窄。

humanitarian.s: This humanitarian group looks for volunteers to distribute meals to the homeless during the month of December.
humanitarian.t: 这个人道主义组织正在找志愿者在12月份把饭分给无家可归的人。

distribute.s: This humanitarian group looks for volunteers to distribute meals to the homeless during the month of December.
distribute.t: 这个人道主义组织正在找志愿者在12月份把饭分给无家可归的人。

stimulation.s: There's a big difference between reading for pleasure and stimulation and reading for knowledge and education.
stimulation.t: 为享受和生命激活而读书，和为知识和教化而读书，是两码事。

stimulation.s: Just as the body needs exercise, so the mind needs stimulation to stay healthy.
stimulation.t: 正如身体需要锻炼，所以心灵需要刺激才能保持健康。

gum.s: Some gum stuck to his shoes.
gum.t: 口香糖粘到他的鞋子上了。

hiv.s: Condoms are an effective measure to prevent HIV and many other diseases.
hiv.t: 避孕套是预防艾滋病和许多其他疾病的有效手段。

port.s: Kobe is famous for its port.

swiss.t: 靠！瑞士的火车什么都有！

fold.s: Teach me how to fold a paper crane. I forgot how to fold it.
fold.t: 教我怎么折纸鹤吧。我忘记怎么折了。

dizzy.s: You looked like you were dizzy.
I get dizzy spells when I stand up.
dizzy.t: 我一站起来就觉得头晕。

dug.s: We dug a hole in the ground.
dug.t: 我们在地上掘了一个洞。

dug.s: The boy dug a grave for his dog that had died.
dug.t: 孩子给他刚死了的狗挖了个坟。

stir.s: I don't want to stir up old memories.
stir.t: 我不愿意勾起久远的回忆。

garlic.s: He gave me 12 cloves of garlic.

knee.t: 玛丽处理了膝盖的伤口。

butt.s: Mr. Goat Butt never told me there would be a partner.
butt.t: 羊屁股先生可没告诉我还有搭档。

egyptian.s: How many US dollars are in an Egyptian pound?
Champollion deciphered the Ancient Egyptian language.
egyptian.t: 商博良破译了古埃及语。

pope.s: The Pope has no right to marry.
I don't care that you're the Pope; you can't touch my feet.
pope.t: 我才不管您是不是个甚么教皇，我的脚您别碰。

tower.s: Did you visit the Tokyo Tower?

bully.s: The bully stomped on his schoolmate’s lunchbox out of spite.
bully.t: 恶霸恶劣地践踏同学的午餐便当。

greedy.s: A miser hoards money not because he is prudent but because he is greedy.
greedy.t: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。

humble.s: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
humble.t: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。

humble.s: The humble man is getting along with his neighbors.
humble.t: 那个谦逊的男人跟邻里相处得很好。

magic.t: 女孩变魔术一样地消失了。

dice.s: He had his girlfriend blow on the dice for luck before he threw them.
dice.t: 他掷骰子之前让他的女友在上面吹气来给他带来好运。

pun.t: 不过是一个文字游戏罢了。

holy.s: Jerusalem is the Holy City of the Jews.
holy.t: 耶路撒冷是犹太人的圣城。

holy.s: The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
holy.t: 你如果看见圣灵降下，落在谁身上，谁就是用圣灵替人施洗的了。

liquid.s: You should drink a lot of liquid.
I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.

arab.s: Japan relies on Arab countries for oil.
arab.t: 日本靠阿拉伯国家提供石油。

silk.s: I sewed the dress with silk thread.
silk.t: 我用丝线缝了这条裙子。

wolves.s: I saw wolves in the Appennines.
wolves.t: 我在亚平宁山脉看到了狼。
一般来说，狼不会攻击人。

detective.s: She described him as a detective.

detective.t: 他偶尔会阅读一些侦探小说。

lawn.s: Mother told me to mow the lawn.

whistle.s: He began to whistle a tune.
The referee blew the whistle and called a hand ball on him.
whistle.t: 裁判吹响了口哨，判定他手球。

whisky.s: How do you like this whisky?
whisky.t: 你觉得这威士忌怎么样？

egypt.s: I wish to visit Egypt someday.
Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

donkey.s: That's not a horse, it's a donkey.
Jessie urged the little donkey forward.

ruins.t: 这座城市成为了一片废墟。

hunting.s: Tom and Mary went deer hunting.

lion.s: Every dog is a lion at home.
lion.t: 每条狗在自己家就是狮子。

lion.s: I was surprised to see a lion.
lion.t: 我很惊讶竟然看到了狮子。

hamlet.s: He played the part of Hamlet.
hamlet.t: 他扮演哈姆雷特的角色。

kite.s: He flew a kite with his son.
kite.t: 他和他的儿子放风筝了。

kite.s: I bought a kite to give to you.

deceitful.s: One of the reasons that we love nature is that, unlike ourselves, nature is not envious or deceitful.
deceitful.t: 我们之所以爱自然——其原由之一，至少是由于它不像我们人那样既嫉妒又欺骗。

beggar.s: I gave the beggar what money I had.
beggar.t: 我把身上的钱全都给了那个乞丐。

beggar.s: The beggar is collecting stale bread.
beggar.t: 这名乞丐在收集干面包。

trump.t: 特朗普想把格陵兰岛买下来。

candle.s: The candle went out by itself.

orphan.s: He was an orphan and illiterate.
orphan.t: 他是个孤儿，而且不识字。

fisherman.s: My father is a skilled fisherman.
The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.
fisherman.t: 渔民用他的网捕到了一只紫色的水母。

mystery.s: What happened to them is still a mystery.
mystery.t: 在他们身上发生了什么仍然是个谜。

rope.s: I let go of the rope.

sunflower.s: They eat sunflower seeds while playing cards.
sunflower.t: 他们一边嗑香瓜子，一边打牌。

camel.s: A camel is, so to speak, a ship on the desert.
camel.t: 骆驼，这么说吧，也就是沙漠中的船。

doll.t: 我做了一个洋娃娃给安。

camping.t: 他们每年夏天都会去露营。

cruel.s: How can you be so cruel?

resist.t: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。

resist.s: No man can resist the lure of a woman.
resist.t: 没有男人能够抵挡女人的诱惑。

miracle.s: I can hope for a miracle, can't I?
miracle.t: 我能等奇迹发生，是不是？

miracle.s: Love is the miracle of civilization.

illiterate.s: He was an orphan and illiterate.
illiterate.t: 他是个孤儿，而且不识字。

magician.s: I want to be a magician.

popcorn.s: I bought two bags of popcorn.

popcorn.t: 爆米花是我最喜欢的零食。

cigar.s: Tom had a cigar in his mouth.
cigar.t: 汤姆在嘴里叼了根儿烟。

cigar.s: I watched a ring of smoke that floated from his cigar into the air.
cigar.t: 我看著一轮烟圈从他的雪茄里冒出来，飘到了空气中。

rubber.s: Sorry, I won't do it without a rubber.
rubber.t: 对不起，但是如果不用避孕套的话我不做。

rubber.s: Rubber is not hard: it gives way to pressure.
rubber.t: 橡皮不硬：它在压力下会变形。

ashtray.t: 我把你的烟灰缸打破了。

ashtray.s: Kissing a person who smokes is like licking an ashtray.
ashtray.t: 亲吻一个抽烟的人就像在舔烟灰缸。

canoe.s: We went down a river by canoe.
canoe.t: 我们乘著独木舟向河的下游而行。

tailor.s: Father always has the tailor make his suits.
tailor.t: 父亲总是让这位裁缝师为他做西装。

bee.s: Bee stings can be very painful.
bee.t: 蜜蜂螫人可以是非常痛苦的。

bee.s: You are always as busy as a bee.
bee.t: 你总是跟蜜蜂一样地忙碌。

lotion.s: Can you put some suntan lotion on my back?
lotion.t: 你能在我的背上涂些防晒霜吗？

philosophy.s: Philosophy is the love of wisdom.

philosophy.t: 汤姆在大学里学的是哲学。

candlelight.s: Instead of preparing a dinner by candlelight, she put her boyfriend up for auction on eBay.
candlelight.t: 她没有准备烛光晚餐，而是把她的男友放到Ebay上拍卖。

tire.s: My bicycle has a flat tire.
tire.t: 我的脚踏车轮胎没气了。

convex.s: If human life is convex, we can optimize it.
convex.t: 如果人生是凸的，那我们可以优化它。

vodka.s: Tom is in the other room drinking vodka.

sweden.s: Sweden has a language of its own.

revenge.s: You killed my father. Today, I want revenge.
revenge.t: 你杀了我的父亲，今天我要报仇。

revenge.s: They set fire to their neighbour's house in revenge.
revenge.t: 为了报仇，他们放火烧了邻居的家。

pepper.s: Do you want pepper on it?
Add salt and pepper to taste.

socialist.s: The Socialist Party only got 18% of the votes.
socialist.t: 社会主义党仅仅获得了百分之18的选票。

grace.s: Grace goes upstairs to the extension telephone.
grace.t: 格雷斯去楼上的分机电话。

scar.s: Tom has a scar on his cheek.
scar.t: 汤姆的脸颊上有一块伤痕。

scar.s: I'll still have a scar from that accident.
scar.t: 我还留着那起事故的伤疤。

parrot.s: She keeps a parrot as a pet.
parrot.t: 她养一只鹦鹉作为宠物。

parrot.s: A parrot can mimic a person's voice.

bible.s: He's reading the Bible in Berber.
bible.t: 他在用伯伯尔语阅读圣经。

prejudice.s: He has a prejudice against foreigners.

apologise.t: 快回去把作业写完，明天再向老师道歉吧！

remedy.t: 笑容是坏心情的最佳药方。

nasty.t: 她每次看见我都给露出厌恶的眼神。

barrel.s: Political power grows out of the barrel of a gun.

transistor.s: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.

exhibit.t: 我要把我的玫瑰拿到花展上展示。

ax.t: 他用斧头重重的斩了一下，那棵树就倒了下来。

preach.s: The main duty of a priest is to preach in church.
preach.t: 牧师的主要职责是在教堂里讲道。

punishment.s: Many countries have abolished capital punishment.
punishment.t: 许多国家已经废除了死刑。

punishment.s: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
punishment.t: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

faraway.s: A good neighbour is better than a faraway friend.
faraway.t: 一个好邻居胜于一个遥远的朋友。

shrill.s: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
shrill.t: 突然间她开始用尖锐的声音大喊。

shrill.s: I was walking along the crowded street when all at once I heard a shrill cry.
shrill.t: 我在人来人往的街道上走著，突然听见一下尖锐的叫声。

sentiment.s: Anti-Chinese sentiment is on the rise in Myanmar.
sentiment.t: 缅甸反华情绪正在增长。

dissatisfaction.s: Her remarks caused dissatisfaction in the public.
dissatisfaction.t: 她的言论引起了舆论的不满。

dissatisfaction.s: The residents expressed their dissatisfaction at the noise.
dissatisfaction.t: 居民们对噪音表示了不满。

moat.s: The river outside of the castle is called a moat.
moat.t: 城堡外面的河叫做护城河。

heritage.s: Ironbridge Gorge is a Unesco world heritage site.
heritage.t: 铁桥峡谷是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

heritage.s: Is it true that our genetic heritage is almost the same as that of chimpanzees?
heritage.t: 我们的遗传基因真的和黑猩猩几乎一样吗？

invigilate.s: We went to a secondary school to invigilate today.
invigilate.t: 我们今天去一所中学监考了。

requirement.s: So friendship is also a requirement for happiness.
requirement.t: 所以，友情也是幸福的一个要素。

requirement.s: Claiming that money is not a requirement for happiness is foolish.
requirement.t: 声称钱不是幸福的一个要素是愚蠢的。

fixing.s: I'm fixing the radio which I found on my way home.
fixing.t: 我在修理回家路上捡到的收音机。

situated.s: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.

loneliness.s: Loneliness and being alone are not the same thing.

loneliness.t: 孤独的人会孤独，是因为他畏惧他人。

loneliness.s: Music is inner life, and he will never suffer loneliness who has inner life.
loneliness.t: 音乐是内心世界，拥有了内心世界的他永远不会觉得孤独。

liver.s: I have a corner in my liver just for you, alcohol.
liver.t: 我在肝里给你留了个地方，酒精啊。

storage.s: My phone needs to have enough storage for my apps.
storage.t: 我的手机需要足够存储空间来下载App。

sensation.s: The hair style of the Beatles created a sensation.
sensation.t: 披头士的发型引起了轰动。

widow.s: The widow mourned for her husband for a long time.
widow.t: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

frustrated.s: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?
frustrated.t: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？

frustrated.s: The frustrated artist stomped on his failed painting, leaving a trail of shattered colors.
frustrated.t: 画家失望地践踏失败之作，留下一片混乱的色彩。

nourish.s: The role of the placenta is to nourish the foetus.
nourish.t: 胎盘的角色是滋养胎儿。

foetus.s: The role of the placenta is to nourish the foetus.
foetus.t: 胎盘的角色是滋养胎儿。

aids.t: 科学家们正努力终结艾滋病。

aids.t: 真希望科学家们能早点找到艾滋病的治疗方法。

refresh.s: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
refresh.t: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。

acupuncture.s: Many people believe acupuncture can cure diseases.
acupuncture.t: 很多人都相信针灸有治愈疾病的功效。

spit.s: In Singapore, it is a crime to spit on the ground.
spit.t: 随地吐痰在新加坡算是犯罪行为。

homicide.s: Make no mistake, we're looking at a homicide case.
homicide.t: 毫无疑问，我们正在调查一桩命案。

rustle.s: The leaves on the trees rustle gently in the wind.

hunch.s: Tom had a hunch that Mary was seeing someone else.
hunch.t: 汤姆预感到玛丽在见别人。

vice.t: 他们提名卡尔文•柯立芝为副总统。

vice.s: To change the units from metric to imperial and vice versa, the 'menu' button must be clicked.
vice.t: 要把公制单位换算成英制或反过来操作，须点击“菜单”按钮。

sincerely.t: 我不会原谅你，除非你真诚地道歉。

stormy.t: 这天刮着暴风雪，雪下得很大。

stormy.s: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
stormy.t: 我认为在有风暴的时候里登山很危险。

carefree.s: My parents live a carefree life in the countryside.
carefree.t: 我父母在乡村过着无忧无虑的生活。

sway.s: From the time he got up, his beliefs began to sway.
sway.t: 从那时起，他的信仰开始摇动了。

gecko.s: Almost stepped on a gecko while going to the metro.
gecko.t: 去地铁的路上差点踩到一只壁虎。

litter.s: A lot of people climb the railing, and even litter.
litter.t: 很多人跳过栏杆，还丢垃圾。

imprisonment.s: The judge sentenced him to one year's imprisonment.
imprisonment.t: 法官判了他一年有期徒刑。

botanical.s: We found many strange plants in a botanical garden.
botanical.t: 我们在一家植物园里找到了许多稀奇古怪的植物。

axis.s: The earth revolves on its axis once every 24 hours.
axis.t: 地球每二十四小时就会绕轴自转一周。

spear.s: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
spear.t: 矛尖浸在一种致命的毒药里。

compliant.t: 根据习俗，新娘应该循规蹈矩。

addiction.t: “网络成瘾症”这个理念将意味着“网络”是一种可以下定义的活动。

addiction.s: People “diagnosed” with “Internet addiction” are nearly always diagnosed with other difficulties as well.
addiction.t: 诊断患有“网络成瘾症”的人差不多总是也有其他的困难。

enable.s: This bird's large wings enable it to fly very fast.
enable.t: 那只鸟凭借自己巨大的翅膀能飞得很快。

torrential.s: The hillside had torrential flooding from the west.

cosmos.s: To date nobody knows the actual size of the cosmos.
cosmos.t: 宇宙的实际大小至今无人知道。

cosmos.s: The telescope has opened a new eye onto the cosmos that has been transformative for our civilization.
cosmos.t: 望远镜为我们的文明开启了一种全新的视角来观察宇宙。

touching.t: 放开我的手臂！我不能忍受有人碰我。

swore.t: 你的言行会跟你的父母一样，即使你曾发誓你永远不会这么做。

oath.s: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.

allegiance.s: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.

jellyfish.s: The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.
jellyfish.t: 渔民用他的网捕到了一只紫色的水母。

motorbike.t: 提姆的摩托车比我的贵多了。

motorbike.t: 开摩托车不戴头盔是很危险的。

exploit.t: 资本家倾向于压榨工人。

mule.t: 老人在骡子的背上放上了一个个装满了沙的袋子。

herb.t: 用于那个义大利酱的香草可能是荷兰芹。

parsley.s: The herb used in that pasta sauce might be parsley.
parsley.t: 用于那个义大利酱的香草可能是荷兰芹。

parsley.t: 这个汤里有胡萝卜、洋葱、欧芹、芹菜和土豆。

lute.t: 最早的琵琶大约在秦朝时期发明的。

freshly.s: Egg tarts, when freshly baked, are a real delicacy.

freshly.s: The farmer warned the children not to stomp on the freshly planted crops.
freshly.t: 农夫警告孩子们不要践踏新栽种的作物。

freshly.s: I have the power of invisibility, but it only works when I’m wearing a freshly washed shirt.
freshly.t: 我有隐身之能，不过仅限于我穿一件刚洗过的上衣的时候。

delicacy.s: Egg tarts, when freshly baked, are a real delicacy.
delicacy.t: 新鲜出炉的蛋挞味道一流。

cameo.t: 劳勃狄尼洛在那场电场中客串演出。

ice-cream.s: The ice-cream will melt, so I put it in the fridge.
ice-cream.t: 冰淇淋会融化所以我把它放在冰箱里。

ice-cream.s: If and only if the ice-cream is vanilla flavour will Xiao Wang eat it.
ice-cream.t: 当且仅当冰淇淋是香草口味，小王会吃这个冰淇淋。

twisted.s: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.

nitrogen.s: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
nitrogen.t: 我们呼吸的空气是由氧气和氮气组成的。

touchdown.s: In American football, a touchdown scores six points.
touchdown.t: 美式足球中，攻方持球触地得分值6分。

harbour.s: The lost fishing boat made a safe return to harbour.
harbour.t: 迷路的渔船安全地返回了港口。

zulu.s: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
zulu.t: 南非的祖鲁族人有著自己独特的语言。

relaxing.s: There is nothing as relaxing as lying in a hot bath.
relaxing.t: 世上没有甚么东西比泡热水浴更舒服的了。

bare.s: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
bare.t: 空手赤拳抓野兔并不容易。

appoint.s: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
appoint.t: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

stairway.s: In an emergency, use the stairway, not the elevator.
stairway.t: 事故发生时，敬勿使用电梯，请使用楼梯。

stairway.t: 玛丽难以相信汤姆从来没有听过《通往天堂的阶梯》。

frugal.s: She is used to living a hardworking and frugal life.

theoretical.s: The Greeks invented a theoretical model of geometry.
theoretical.t: 希腊人建立了几何学的理论模型。

rickety.t: 新生的长颈鹿摇晃著腿跌跌撞撞地走。

deity.t: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？

canberra.t: 澳大利亚的首都是堪培拉，不是墨尔本。

cramp.t: 我刚刚腿又抽筋了，痛死我了。

jumbo.t: 尾崎将司是日本最受欢迎的专业高尔夫球手。

woodpecker.t: 啄木鸟正在使劲地啄树干。

vigorously.s: The woodpecker is pecking the tree trunk vigorously.
vigorously.t: 啄木鸟正在使劲地啄树干。

discreet.s: Mary told me that she thought Tom would be discreet.
discreet.t: 玛丽跟我说他觉得汤姆很谨慎。

factor.s: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
factor.t: 诚实是他成功最重要的因素。

factor.s: When applying to American universities, your TOEFL score is only one factor.
factor.t: 当您登记美国大学时，您考TOEFL获得的分数只是所选因素的其中一个。

factor.s: Another factor to be taken into consideration is that the present situation is favourable to us.
factor.t: 将要考虑的另一个重要因素是，目前的情况对我们有利。

frequency.s: The recent frequency of earthquakes makes us nervous.
frequency.t: 最近频繁的地震让我们很焦虑。

reexamine.s: He intended to reexamine the case from the beginning.
reexamine.t: 他打算从头开始重新审查这个案件。

cyber.s: Cyber activists want to meet with the Supreme Leader.
cyber.t: 网络积极分子想跟最高领袖见面。

hoax.s: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
hoax.t: 我的祖父相信登月是一个骗局。

studious.s: No other boy in our class is more studious than Jack.
studious.t: 我们班级里没有比杰克更勤奋的男孩了。

logistics.s: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.
logistics.t: 外行谈策略，内行谈后勤。

conglomerate.s: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.

impartially.s: Teachers should treat all their students impartially.
impartially.t: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。

fighter.s: One man's terrorist is another man's freedom fighter.
fighter.t: 一个人的恐怖分子为另人的自由战士。

extraordinarily.s: A clear conscience is an extraordinarily soft pillow.
extraordinarily.t: 问心无愧是一个非常柔软的枕头。

epidemic.s: Thousands upon thousands have died from the epidemic.
epidemic.t: 成千上万的人死于瘟疫。

legally.s: Mary and Alice are a legally married same sex couple.
legally.t: Mary和Alice是一对合法结婚的同性伴侣。

pneumonia.s: He's got pneumonia. No wonder he is coughing nonstop.
pneumonia.t: 他得了肺炎，难怪他在不停的咳嗽。

producer.s: Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.
producer.t: 澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。

costume.t: 萨米是唯一一个能穿上这件衣服的人。

embarrassment.s: Giggling with embarrassment, she held out the condom.
embarrassment.t: 她害羞地笑着拿出了避孕套。

disappearance.s: We have to look into the disappearance of the doctor.
disappearance.t: 我们必须调查医生的失踪案。

disappearance.s: The police now believe that Tom had something to do with Mary's disappearance.
disappearance.t: 警方现在认为汤姆和玛丽的失踪有干系。

hallway.s: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.

hallway.t: 每次学生在走廊上制造混乱的时候，校长都会严厉地训斥他们。

wheelchair.s: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.

eternity.s: The two lovers swore to love each other for eternity.
eternity.t: 两个恋人发誓永远相爱。

eternity.s: There will always be things I will never learn, I don't have eternity before me!
eternity.t: 总有一些东西我永远不能学会，我的生命不是永恒的！

eternity.s: Never knew before what eternity was made for. It is to give some of us a chance to learn German.
eternity.t: 以前从来不知道永恒是为了什么。它是为了给我们一些机会学习德语。

fable.s: "Drawing dragons and dotting in the eyes" is a fable.
fable.t: 画龙点睛是一则寓言故事。

lotus.s: The temples on Mars are decorated with lotus flowers.
lotus.t: 火星上的神殿饰有莲花。

perpetual.s: The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
perpetual.t: 永动机这个概念是个荒唐的假说。

boundary.s: The Rhine is the boundary between France and Germany.
boundary.t: 莱茵河是分隔法国和德国的界线。

boundary.s: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
boundary.t: 我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。

boundary.s: Sebatik Island is one of the boundary regions between Indonesia and Malaysia.
boundary.t: Sebatik岛是印度尼西亚和马来西亚的边境地区之一。

impotence.s: Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.
impotence.t: 酗酒是导致阳痿的一个因素。

irritation.s: Mary smiled, but her voice had some irritation in it.
irritation.t: 玛丽微笑，但是声音带著些许气恼。

tiring.s: When man and woman unite, work is no longer as tiring.

imperial.t: 最高法院位于皇宫附近。

imperial.t: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

imperial.s: Aristocrats lived to the east and west of the imperial palace.
imperial.t: 贵族住在故宫的东边和西边。

subtle.t: 这两张图片之间有细致的差异。

bale.t: 贝尔被犯规了，球队获得了任意球。

porridge.t: 唯有加很多糖才能让我喝得下粥。

tempest.t: 婆婆和媳妇就像是暴风雨和冰雹。

pyramid.s: There's a pyramid in Mexico bigger than any of those in Egypt.
pyramid.t: 在墨西哥有一座金字塔比在埃及的任何一座都大。

premature.s: There is no greater insult to life than premature ejaculation.
premature.t: 没有什么比早泄更糟蹋生活的了

excursion.s: A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
excursion.t: 旅行社会为你安排去安达卢西亚的旅行。

withdrawal.s: The Soviet troops have started the withdrawal from Afghanistan.
withdrawal.t: 苏联军队开始从阿富汗撤军了。

withdrawal.s: If these drugs are stopped abruptly, then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
withdrawal.t: 如果这些药突然被停了，那可能会出现一些戒断症状。

understandable.s: They spoke of their high exam grades with understandable pride.
understandable.t: 他们很骄傲地谈到考试中的好成绩，这种骄傲是可以理解的。

endeavor.s: Self-confidence is the principal element of any great endeavor.
endeavor.t: 自信是伟大事业的第一要素。

fatigue.s: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.
fatigue.t: 他疲劳过度，又睡眠不足，最后便病倒了。

senator.s: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
senator.t: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

congressional.s: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
congressional.t: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

hostage.s: Russia expresses regret for those lost in the hostage incident.
hostage.t: 俄罗斯对在人质事件中牺牲的人们表示哀悼。

pantry.s: Could you please find the missing key. I can't open the pantry.
pantry.t: 你能帮忙寻找丢失的钥匙吗?我打不开食品柜。

hound.s: What beast dost thou think thou art? Art thou a hound or a rat?
hound.t: 你认为你是什么野兽？猎犬还是老鼠？

gallery.s: It absolutely wasn't Mary who went with him to the art gallery.
gallery.t: 和他一起去美术馆的人并不是玛丽。

ingenious.s: Everyone's tricks are different; each differs in ingenious ways.
ingenious.t: 戏法人人会变，各有巧妙不同。

diameter.s: Is it possible to determine the diameter from the circumference?
diameter.t: 用圆周能不能求得直径？

circumference.s: Is it possible to determine the diameter from the circumference?
circumference.t: 用圆周能不能求得直径？

restrictions.s: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.
restrictions.t: 对严格限制经济的批评蜂拥而来。

cypress.s: The main type of tree in this part of the forest is the cypress.
cypress.t: 这片森林的树主要是柏树。

thirteenth.s: A few days after his thirteenth birthday, Tony left school, too.
thirteenth.t: 在他13岁生日后几天，汤尼也离开了学校。

stool.s: If you stand on this stool, you can reach the top of the closet.
stool.t: 站在这个凳子上的话，你可以摸到衣柜顶。

donation.s: Would the girls please bring the donation boxes up to the stage?
donation.t: 我们请女孩带着募捐箱来到舞台。

hemorrhage.s: My father died of a subarachnoid hemorrhage when I was fourteen.
hemorrhage.t: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。

unavailable.s: We're sorry. The number you have dialed is currently unavailable.
unavailable.t: 对不起，您拨打的用户暂时无法接通。

exploration.s: Is it necessary to expand human knowledge with space exploration?
exploration.t: 是否有必要通过探索太空来增长人类的知识？

exploration.s: I love how WHAT THE CAR? combines racing with quirky puzzles and exploration.
exploration.t: 我喜欢《WHATTHECAR?》将赛车与有趣的益智游戏和探索相结合。

equilibrium.s: We could apply the theory of punctuated equilibrium to languages.
equilibrium.t: 我们可以把间断平衡理论应用到语言上。

malfunction.s: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
malfunction.t: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。

whip.s: In Singapore, one way to punish a criminal is to whip him or her.
whip.t: 在新加坡，鞭刑是处置犯人的方法之一。

pharmacist.s: You should consult with a pharmacist before buying that medicine.
pharmacist.t: 你在买这药之前应该问一下药剂师的建议。

discharge.s: The crowd obstructed the police in the discharge of their duties.
discharge.t: 群众妨碍了警员执行任务。

make-up.s: I'm a make-up artist. I can turn any girl into a beautiful woman.
make-up.t: 我是个化妆师，每当我把一个姑娘变成大美女。

make-up.s: It's embarrassing to be seen without make-up so please don't stare.
make-up.t: 素颜太害羞了，请不要盯着我看。

classic.s: Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
classic.t: 麦根沙士被视为一种经典的美式碳酸饮品。

classic.s: The qipao is a classic female garment that originated in 17th century China.
classic.t: 旗袍是一种17世纪起源于中国的传统式样的女性服装。

saxon.s: Drents is a group of variants of the Low Saxon regional language.
saxon.t: 德伦特方言是低地撒克逊地区的一个方言群。

miniscule.s: The difference between bragging and being ambitious is miniscule.
miniscule.t: 吹嘘与雄心的差别甚小。

echo.s: We heard the echo of our voices from the other side of the valley.
echo.t: 我们听见自己说话的回音从山谷的另一边传了回来。

blacken.s: Blacken the circles next to the correct answers with an HB pencil.
blacken.t: 请用HB铅笔把正确答案旁边的圆圈填满。

turnover.s: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.
turnover.t: 这家公司去年获得显著的营业额增长。

clan.s: The clan system is a key component of traditional Chinese culture.
clan.t: 宗族制度是中国传统文化的重要组成部分。

component.s: The clan system is a key component of traditional Chinese culture.
component.t: 宗族制度是中国传统文化的重要组成部分。

drought.s: Last year the region was visited by the worst drought in 60 years.
drought.t: 去年那个地区遭受了60年来最严重的干旱。

mentality.s: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
mentality.t: 攀比心理会让人产生负面情绪。

lantern.s: It is a must to guess lantern riddles during the Lantern Festival.

gossip.s: The only time people dislike gossip is when you gossip about them.
gossip.t: 人们不喜欢流言蜚语的唯一时间是当你闲聊他们的事。

enthusiastically.s: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
enthusiastically.t: 她热忱地投身于这份光荣的事业。

undertaking.s: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
undertaking.t: 她热忱地投身于这份光荣的事业。

buckle.s: It's the law: always buckle your safety belt in cars and airplanes.
buckle.t: 法律规定，在车辆和飞机上，一定要扣上安全带。

prudent.s: A prudent bird chooses its tree. A wise servant chooses his master.
prudent.t: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事。

prudent.s: A miser hoards money not because he is prudent but because he is greedy.
prudent.t: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。

servant.s: A prudent bird chooses its tree. A wise servant chooses his master.
servant.t: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事。

servant.s: The mind should be a good servant, but the heart should be the master.
servant.t: 心灵应该当一个好仆人，但心应该是主人。

servant.s: Jiang Feng's servant hired the "Twelve Zodiacs" to kill him. They ambushed him and his wife Yuenu.
servant.t: 江枫的仆人雇了十二生肖杀江枫，他们伏击了江枫和江枫的妻子月奴。

waterfront.s: The Edinburgh Waterfront project could be about to change all that.
waterfront.t: 爱丁堡的水边地工程可能会把诸如此类的事情改变。

waterfront.s: Edinburgh's Waterfront is just one of the many projects that are regenerating UK towns and cities.
waterfront.t: 爱丁堡的水边地工程只是许多重建联合王国城镇的工程之一。

observation.s: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
observation.t: 她因为敏锐的观察力，很适合当一名摄影师。

circuit.s: I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.
circuit.t: 我把果酱撒到电源插座上短路了。

chain.s: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
chain.t: 我们想和一个阿尔及利亚的供应商一起打造一条新的供应链。

chain.s: In a horrifying chain of events, Christopher Columbus once bit his own lip.
chain.t: 在一连串可怕的事件中,哥伦布曾经咬紧牙关撑过去。

supplier.s: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
supplier.t: 我们想和一个阿尔及利亚的供应商一起打造一条新的供应链。

cockroach.s: I bet my friend $100 that he wouldn't eat a live cockroach. I lost!
cockroach.t: 我用100美元跟我的朋友赌他不会吃活蟑螂。我输了！

optional.s: Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
optional.t: 生命中你无法选择接踵而至的挑战，但是你可以选择不成为一个失败者。

crab.s: The first person who ate crab must also have tried to eat a spider.
crab.t: 第一个吃螃蟹的人一定也吃过蜘蛛。

crab.s: Look, look! On the branch of the orange tree, there is a blue hermit crab!
crab.t: 快看快看！橙子树的树枝上有一只蓝色的寄居蟹！

revise.s: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
revise.t: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

arson.s: The fire that broke out last night was judged to be caused by arson.
arson.t: 昨晚的火灾被断定为由纵火引起的。

depict.s: I'm not a poet; I couldn't write a single line to depict its beauty.
depict.t: 我不是诗人，无法用一行文字描绘它的美丽。

almanac.s: In an almanac you can find information about the phases of the moon.
almanac.t: 你可以在年鉴中找到月相的资讯。

grief.s: She was filled with deep grief to hear of her father's sudden death.
grief.t: 她得知父亲突然离世，不禁心如刀割。

oily.s: My clothes have an oily smell because I ate at an okonomiyaki place.
oily.t: 我去了一家什锦烧店吃东西，所以身上的衣服都沾上了一股油味。

democrat.s: A democrat is a free citizen who yields to the will of the majority.
democrat.t: 民主主义者是屈服于大部分人的自由公民。

treason.s: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
treason.t: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

technique.s: Shougongsha is an old Chinese technique to test a woman's virginity.
technique.t: 守宫砂是中国古代用来验证女人贞操的方法.

virginity.s: Shougongsha is an old Chinese technique to test a woman's virginity.
virginity.t: 守宫砂是中国古代用来验证女人贞操的方法.

feedback.s: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
feedback.t: 公司欢迎消费者对他们产品的反馈

janitor.s: Tom started as a janitor, but he's now the president of the company.
janitor.t: 汤姆最初是看门人，但现在他是公司的总裁了。

cursory.s: A cursory examination of his teeth indicated that he had gingivitis.
cursory.t: 一个简单的牙齿检查显示他有牙龈炎。

shuttle.s: How long does it take for the airport shuttle to get to the airport?
shuttle.t: 穿梭班车到机场需要多长时间？

berry.t: "Vaya"的意思是"哇哦"，"baya"的意思是"浆果"，"valla"的意思是"栅栏"。

recruit.s: The plan is to recruit 5 Java engineers before the end of next month.
recruit.t: 计划是在下月底之前招聘5名Java工程师。

refute.s: The witnesses were able to refute the false testimony of the suspect.
refute.t: 证人可以反驳犯罪嫌疑人的虚假证词。

magnitude.s: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
magnitude.t: 今天8.8级的强大地震袭击了日本的岛屿。

sixth.s: The sixth Prime Minister of Malaysia is Dato' Seri Najib Abdul Razak.
sixth.t: 马来西亚第六任首相是拿督斯利纳吉·阿都拉萨。

gratify.s: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
gratify.t: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。

full-time.s: The referee blew his whistle twice to tell everyone it was full-time.
full-time.t: 裁判吹哨两次，向大家宣布已经终场。

doughnut.s: Many of Europe's metropolises are plagued by the doughnut phenomenon.
doughnut.t: 许多欧洲的大都市饱受“甜甜圈现象”困扰。

blemish.s: Her skin was white as milk and she had not a single blemish anywhere.
blemish.t: 她的肌肤如同牛奶一样洁白，身上没有一处斑点。

pant.s: Tom rolled up his pant legs so people could see his bright red socks.
pant.t: 汤姆卷起了他的裤腿，好让人看到他鲜红色的袜子。

sane.s: Rousseau was mad but influential; Hume was sane but had no followers.
sane.t: 卢梭是疯狂的,但有影响力;休谟是理智的,但没有追随者。

implication.t: 含义是哪里有水井，哪里就有居民。

interference.s: I won't allow you to continue your interference in my daughter's life.
interference.t: 我不允许你继续干涉我女儿的生活。

subjunctive.s: Today, we are going to unravel the mystery of the English subjunctive.
subjunctive.t: 今天我们来揭开英文虚拟式的神秘面纱。

wrath.s: All the king's subjects, fearing his wrath, often acted quite servile.
wrath.t: 国王所有的臣民，由于害怕他的愤怒而经常表现得卑躬屈膝。

servile.s: All the king's subjects, fearing his wrath, often acted quite servile.
servile.t: 国王所有的臣民，由于害怕他的愤怒而经常表现得卑躬屈膝。

affluent.s: Humanity is now affluent due to progression in science and technology.
affluent.t: 由于科学技术的进步，人类现在很富裕。

progression.s: Humanity is now affluent due to progression in science and technology.
progression.t: 由于科学技术的进步，人类现在很富裕。

nightingale.s: In the evening quiet, we enjoy the song of the euphonious nightingale.
nightingale.t: 在安静的晚上，我们沉浸在夜莺悦耳的歌声中。

seductive.s: A brilliant, seductive chef turns to espionage in Napoleon-era France.
seductive.t: 拿破仑时代的法国，魅力诱人的天才厨师摇身一变成为间谍。

espionage.s: A brilliant, seductive chef turns to espionage in Napoleon-era France.
espionage.t: 拿破仑时代的法国，魅力诱人的天才厨师摇身一变成为间谍。

rooftop.s: There's a great view from the rooftop of that building. Want to go see?
rooftop.t: 那座大厦天台的景色很美的，想去看看吗？

eastern.s: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
eastern.t: 东欧的酒精消耗量比西欧高。

confrontation.s: Everybody knows that Cold War is the confrontation between two nations.
confrontation.t: 是人都知道冷战是两国的对峙。

deforestation.s: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.
deforestation.t: 棕榈油制造是导致印度尼西亚森林砍伐的主要原因。

scent.s: After washing, the cat's fur is soft and fluffy, and has a faint scent.
scent.t: 洗过澡后，猫咪的毛柔软又蓬松，还有淡淡的香味。

batter.s: To be a good batter, you've got to hang loose and follow your instincts.
batter.t: 想成为一个好的击球手的话，你要在球场上时刻保持镇定，还要学会相信自己的直觉。

consistency.s: I'm so busy running about year in, year out. My life has no consistency.
consistency.t: 长年累月东奔西走忙死了，生活太没有规律了。

fiscal.s: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.
fiscal.t: 减税常被用作刺激经济的主要财政手段。

conspiracy.s: My friend believes conspiracy theories; should I try to prove him wrong?
conspiracy.t: 我的朋友相信阴谋论，我该试着向他指出他错了吗？

plentiful.s: She shed plentiful tears when her beloved dog was killed in an accident.
plentiful.t: 她目睹爱犬在意外中离世，不禁泪如泉涌。

vent.s: I am really extremely angry, so I plan to smash things to vent my anger.
vent.t: 我实在气得不得了，所以打算砸东西发泄。

award.s: In addition, we will issue the 'employee of the month' award afterwards.
award.t: 另外，之后我们会颁发“每月最佳员工”奖。

burial.s: The small hill turned out to be an ancient burial mound 2,000 years old.
burial.t: 这座小山丘原来是一座两千多年的古墓。

mound.s: The small hill turned out to be an ancient burial mound 2,000 years old.
mound.t: 这座小山丘原来是一座两千多年的古墓。

anniversary.s: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
anniversary.t: 汤姆从没忘记在婚礼周年纪念日送给他妻子花。

idolize.s: Is it normal that many young people these days idolize pretty boy stars?
idolize.t: 现在很多年轻人追捧小鲜肉的现象正常吗？

womb.s: Surely he can not enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!
womb.t: 他当然不可能回到娘胎里再出生一次了！

densely.s: The Silesian Voivodeship is the most densely populated region of Poland.
densely.t: 西里西亚省是波兰人口稠密度最大的地区。

blunt.s: My sword may be blunt, but that's more than enough for someone like you.
blunt.t: 我的剑虽然是钝的，但应付你的话是绰绰有余的。

whereabouts.s: Tom can't account for his whereabouts on the day that Mary was murdered.
whereabouts.t: 汤姆不能说明玛丽遇害那天自己在哪里。

remorse.s: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
remorse.t: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。

corporation.s: Toyota Corporation announced that it would cut 1,000 positions this year.
corporation.t: 丰田公司宣布将会在今年裁员一千人。

corporation.s: The multinational corporation has forecast the implementation of economies of scale.
corporation.t: 跨国公司预料到了规模经济的实行。

coastal.s: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.
coastal.t: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。

inland.s: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.
inland.t: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。

asteroid.s: The asteroid broke up into small pieces as it entered Earth's atmosphere.
asteroid.t: 进入地球大气层后，小行星分裂成了无数的小块。

asteroid.s: The space probe Lucy is expected to arrive in 2025 to the proximity of the asteroid Donaldjohanson.
asteroid.t: 太空探测器露西预计将于2025年抵达小行星唐纳德约翰逊附近。

outrageous.s: Politicians are always censured for outrageous or inappropriate behavior.
outrageous.t: 政治家总是因他们丑陋及不合时宜的行为受到惩罚。

austere.s: Ms. Eichler had a notorious reputation for being austere to her students.
austere.t: 艾希勒女士对学生严厉是出了名的。

apparent.s: It's in times like these that the character of a person becomes apparent.
apparent.t: 路遥知马力，日久见人心。

proportion.s: Men's wants become greater in proportion to the increase in their income.
proportion.t: 人收入愈高，欲望就愈大。

malt.s: Beer is taxed according to its malt content, so low-malt beer is cheaper.
malt.t: 因为啤酒会根据麦芽含量去征税，所以发泡酒会比较便宜。

herd.s: The newborn calf couldn't catch up with the herd running from the jaguar.
herd.t: 新生小牛跟不上逃离美洲虎的牛群。

jaguar.s: The newborn calf couldn't catch up with the herd running from the jaguar.
jaguar.t: 新生小牛跟不上逃离美洲虎的牛群。

scorching.s: In the scorching heat, the cat is spread out lethargically on the ground.
scorching.t: 在炎热的天气里，猫咪没精神地摊在地上。

ideally.s: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
ideally.t: 我们希望应聘者能有4年工作经验。

harmless.s: Liberty consists of being able to make everything as harmless as possible.
harmless.t: 自由旨在能够做所有不伤害其他人的事。

reddish.s: What color is your urine: clear, dark yellow, reddish, or brown like beer?
reddish.t: 你的尿液是什么颜色的：浅色的、深黄色的、浅红色的还是像啤酒一样的咖啡色？
