weekly.t: 我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。

lasting.s: No hobby is as cheap as reading, nor provides such long lasting enjoyment.
lasting.t: 没有任何娱乐像阅读这般廉价，也没有任何愉悦像阅读这般持久。

enjoyment.s: No hobby is as cheap as reading, nor provides such long lasting enjoyment.
enjoyment.t: 没有任何娱乐像阅读这般廉价，也没有任何愉悦像阅读这般持久。

paralysis.s: His paralysis is progressing, and soon he won't be able to get out of bed.
paralysis.t: 他的瘫痪正在恶化，不久他就不能下床了。

adequately.s: Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by stupidity.
adequately.t: 能解释为愚蠢的，就不要解释为恶意。

marking.s: There is a fence marking the boundary between our yard and the neighbor's.
marking.t: 我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。

marking.s: The red circle on the calendar marking the deadline causes me to fall into anxiety.
marking.t: 日历上画着红圈的截稿日期使我陷入了焦虑。

lofty.s: No matter what grand and lofty reason you have, it's not right to do this.
lofty.t: 不管你有什么冠冕堂皇的理由，这样做是不对的。

hermit.s: Look, look! On the branch of the orange tree, there is a blue hermit crab!
hermit.t: 快看快看！橙子树的树枝上有一只蓝色的寄居蟹！

promote.s: They implemented a communication policy so as to promote their new concept.
promote.t: 他们到位了实行新概念的广告策略。

inconvenience.s: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
inconvenience.t: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。

perpetuate.s: Lonely people perpetuate their own loneliness through their fear of others.
perpetuate.t: 孤独的人会孤独，是因为他畏惧他人。

strained.s: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
strained.t: 虽然激情可能会褪去，却不容它破坏我们感情上的联系。

faculty.s: I study comparative religion in the arts faculty of the University of Turku.
faculty.t: 我在图尔库大学文化系学习宗教比较学。

scoring.s: The opposition formed a line in the box to try and block Messi from scoring.
scoring.t: 对方球员在禁区内组成一道防线，试图阻截梅西的射门。

scoring.s: Messi was very close to scoring a goal, but the referee blew his whistle to say that he was offside.
scoring.t: 梅西差一点就进球了，但裁判吹哨说他越位。

garment.s: The qipao is a classic female garment that originated in 17th century China.
garment.t: 旗袍是一种17世纪起源于中国的传统式样的女性服装。

importation.s: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
importation.t: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

futile.s: There is nothing which exacts a higher price than revenge, yet is so futile.
futile.t: 没有什么东西比复仇更昂贵，更无益。

demon.s: The demon lord finally lost consciousness and fell to the floor with a thud.
demon.t: 大魔王终于失去知觉，砰的一声倒在了地上。

demon.s: The demon grabbed my sister and, with howling laughter, cast her into a bottomless pit.
demon.t: 恶魔一把抓住了我的妹妹，一边狰狞地狂笑着，一边把她丢进了一个无底洞里。

thud.s: The demon lord finally lost consciousness and fell to the floor with a thud.
thud.t: 大魔王终于失去知觉，砰的一声倒在了地上。

bronze.s: The five yuan coins are brass, and the ten yuan coins are made out of bronze.
bronze.t: 5元硬币是黄铜，10元硬币是青铜做的。

rewarding.s: I like this work because you see the result immediately; it's very rewarding.
rewarding.t: 我喜欢这个工作因为它立竿见影，让人很有成就感。

stern.s: His stern tone and loud voice belied his inner sensitivity and caring nature.
stern.t: 他严肃的口气和他的大声掩盖了他内心的敏感和他亲切的本质。

sensitivity.s: His stern tone and loud voice belied his inner sensitivity and caring nature.
sensitivity.t: 他严肃的口气和他的大声掩盖了他内心的敏感和他亲切的本质。

sham.s: With all its sham, drudgery and broken dreams; it is still a beautiful world.
sham.t: 虽然虚伪、苦痛还有破碎的梦伴随着我，但这仍然是一个美丽的世界。

freak.s: I hate those spiders. They're always there to freak me out when I'm cleaning.
freak.t: 我讨厌那些蜘蛛，我做家务的时候它们总在那里吓我。

pony.s: In my world everyone’s a pony and they all eat rainbows and poop butterflies.
pony.t: 在我的世界上，人人都是小马驹，他们吃了彩虹之后就会啪地一下拉出蝴蝶。

anal.s: After having anal sex with my boyfriend, we usually need to have a good wash.
anal.t: 跟我男友肛交后，我们一般需要把自己洗干净。

anal.s: After having anal sex with my girlfriend, we usually need to have a good wash.
anal.t: 跟我女友肛交后，我们一般需要把自己洗干净。

philosophical.s: We should try to be philosophical about life; wealth gained could also vanish.
philosophical.t: 我们应该努力做到生活的哲学；获得的财富也会烟消云散。

vanish.s: We should try to be philosophical about life; wealth gained could also vanish.
vanish.t: 我们应该努力做到生活的哲学；获得的财富也会烟消云散。

vigour.s: The fireplace, lacking firewood, flames already starting to lose their vigour.
vigour.t: 由于少了木柴，烟囱的火苗已经开始后继无力了。

stall.s: For years he has been at the market every Tuesday morning with his fish stall.
stall.t: 他在街市卖鱼卖了许多年了，这些年来每逢星期二都会在街市见到他。

deference.s: Then I'll work on the principle that deference is no substitute for obedience.
deference.t: 那我就恭敬不如从命啦。

transport.s: It’s like saying that someone is addicted to “transport”, “art” or “politics”.
transport.t: 这个好像说一个人上瘾了“交通”，“艺术”或“政治”。

debut.s: Tom became popular among teenagers as soon as he made his debut on the screen.
debut.t: 汤姆第一次上电视后就广受青少年的欢迎。

proportional.s: The length of a marriage is inversely proportional to the cost of the wedding.
proportional.t: 婚姻的长度与婚宴的花费负相关。

impending.s: Agitated activity by certain animals may be a sign of an impending earthquake.
impending.t: 某些动物烦躁不安,可能是地震临震前的预兆。

eightieth.s: It was Sir Anthony's eightieth birthday concert and everybody wanted a ticket.
eightieth.t: 这是安东尼爵士的八十岁生日音乐会，大家都想要一张入场券。

animated.s: "My new animated movie is called 'Stretchie: End of Clays Part II,'" said Tom.
animated.t: 汤姆说：「我推出的全新动画电影叫做《伸展世界：黏土的末日(下)》。」

bombing.s: 3 Malay nationals and a Filipino were killed in the Davao bombing on Mindanao.
bombing.t: 3个马来西亚侨民与一个菲律宾国民在棉兰老岛达沃市爆炸里被炸死了。

atlantic.s: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
atlantic.t: CharlesLindbergh于1927年成功完成了第一次独自飞越大西洋。

deliberation.s: Actions are successfully achieved with deliberation but ruined by carelessness.

exponential.s: Hey, sir, the function on the blackboard is not exponential, but trigonometric.
exponential.t: 嗨，先生，黑板上的不是指数函数，而是三角函数。

wreckage.s: The wreckage of the ship was salvaged after it had gone to Davy Jones's locker.
wreckage.t: 船的残骸从海底被打捞上来。

managing.s: Managing your stocks with Big Wisdom shows that you are serious about investing!
managing.t: 用大智慧做股票，说明您对投资是认真的！

fruitless.s: The matter can't be changed. No matter how hard we try, everything is fruitless.
fruitless.t: 事情已经定下来了，我们再怎么努力也无济于事了，一切都是马后炮了。

nightfall.s: At nightfall I like following the tradition of taking a walk along the lakeside.
nightfall.t: 傍晚我喜欢沿著湖边散步。

wreath.s: The girl in the picture has a flower wreath on her head, and not a golden crown.
wreath.t: 画中的女孩头上戴著的是花冠，不是金皇冠。

associated.s: Fine words and an insinuating appearance are seldom associated with true virtue.
Hutongs are a type of narrow street, most commonly associated with Beijing, China.
associated.t: 胡同是一种跟中国北京有关的窄街路。

pact.s: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.
pact.t: 明明签订了互不侵犯条约，竟然还来攻击我们。

uproar.s: On the day of my birthday, my friends made me drink and I caused quite an uproar.
uproar.t: 在我生日那天，朋友让我喝酒，我大闹一番。

benevolent.s: He was a benevolent old man who volunteered to mow his neighbors' lawns for free.
benevolent.t: 是一位慈祥的老人自告奋勇地为他的邻居割草坪。

attorney.s: It's totally without precedent for the suspect's attorney to be the true culprit.
attorney.t: 这前所未闻,犯罪嫌疑人的律师竟然是真正的罪魁祸首。

tyrant.s: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.
tyrant.t: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。

persecution.s: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.
persecution.t: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。

african.s: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.
african.t: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。

collaborate.s: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.
collaborate.t: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。

outbreak.s: The next four to six weeks are crucial in controlling the massive Ebola outbreak.
outbreak.t: 接下来的四到六周将对于控制伊波拉病毒的大爆发至关重要。

fireman.s: “Mum, what’s a fireman?” “It’s like someone who does the watering of a building.”
fireman.t: 「妈，消防员是干什么的？」「大概就是给房屋浇水的人。」

wildlife.s: When the World Wildlife Fund was founded in 1961, it took the panda as its symbol.
wildlife.t: 国际野生动物基金在一九六一年创办的时候，以熊猫为象征。

clear-cut.s: People who can express their thoughts in a clear-cut way are very straightforward.
clear-cut.t: 能够直截了当地表达自己想法的人很直爽。

graphic.s: There were some graphic novels mixed into the pile of specialty books on the desk.
graphic.t: 书桌上一叠专业书里有几本卡通书混在里面。

motorcar.s: I am very much surprised to hear that he got badly injured in a motorcar accident.
motorcar.t: 他因车祸受了重伤的消息让我震惊万分。

chord.s: I can't quite figure out what that chord around 1:58 is. Can somebody help me out?
chord.t: 我听来听去也听不到一分五十八秒左右的那个和弦是甚么和弦，有人可以帮帮我吗？

satanic.s: “The Satanic Verses” by Salman Rushdie is a real masterpiece of modern literature.
satanic.t: 萨尔曼·鲁西迪的《撒旦诗篇》是现代文学的真正的杰作

presumptuous.s: It's presumptuous for humans to assume that our task is to do what only God can do.
presumptuous.t: 人类假设我们的任务是完成只有上帝能做的事，这太自以为是了。

additional.s: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
additional.t: 因此，必须进行额外的测试以确保完整的安全性。

somber.s: From the doctor's grim expression, it was clear he had somber news for the patient.
somber.t: 根据医生诚恳的表示，很显然他已经有对病人不太好的消息了。

impress.s: Parents try to impress upon their children the importance of honesty and hard work.
impress.t: 父母试图将诚实和工作的重要性灌输给孩子。

filial.s: There are two things in the world that cannot wait: 1. Filial piety, 2. Doing good.
filial.t: 世上有两件事不能等：一、孝顺二、行善。

piety.s: There are two things in the world that cannot wait: 1. Filial piety, 2. Doing good.
piety.t: 世上有两件事不能等：一、孝顺二、行善。

deteriorate.s: If Tom doesn't take the prescribed medicine, his state of health might deteriorate.
deteriorate.t: 如果汤姆不服用处方药，他的健康状况可能会恶化。

multinational.s: The multinational corporation has forecast the implementation of economies of scale.
multinational.t: 跨国公司预料到了规模经济的实行。

multinational.s: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
multinational.t: 跨国企业远胜于传统的单一国家企业。

implementation.s: The multinational corporation has forecast the implementation of economies of scale.
implementation.t: 跨国公司预料到了规模经济的实行。

consistently.s: However, apart from Buddhists, hardly anyone can consistently follow this principle.
consistently.t: 不过，除了佛教者以外，没有任何人可以一直遵循这个原则。

dispel.s: Her smooth entry into the ranks of the royal family will help to dispel these fears.
dispel.t: 证实她顺利地过渡入皇室组织，有帮于消除这些焦虑。

latter.s: I prefer Noh to Kabuki because I find the former to be more elegant than the latter.
latter.t: 比起歌舞伎，我更喜欢能乐表演，因为我觉得后者比前者优雅。

latter.s: Practice is as important as theory, but we are apt to value the latter and despise the former.
latter.t: 实践和理论同样重要，但我们倾向于重视后者而忽略前者。

tributary.s: During the 15th century, the Ryukyu Kingdom was a tributary state of Imperial China.
tributary.t: 在15世纪，琉球王国是中国帝国的附庸国。

conceit.s: The world tolerates conceit from those who are successful, but not from anybody else.
conceit.t: 世界只能容忍有成就的人的自傲。

brink.s: First Contact became humanity's salvation as it was at the brink of self-destruction.
brink.t: 在人类自我毁灭的边缘，第一次接触成了福音。

brink.s: Due to total Russification in Belarus, the Belarusian language is on the brink of extinction.
brink.t: 由于完全的俄罗斯化在白俄罗斯里，白俄罗斯语在绝灭的边缘。

cascade.s: As this is a cascade with multiple layers, it shouldn't be surprising that it's slow.
cascade.t: 因为这是一个有好几层的瀑布，所以速度慢也不会让人惊讶。

peacock.s: I just saw a beautiful peacock displaying its feathers while on a walk in the forest.
peacock.t: 我刚才在树林里散步时看见了一只漂亮的孔雀在开屏。

displaying.s: I just saw a beautiful peacock displaying its feathers while on a walk in the forest.
displaying.t: 我刚才在树林里散步时看见了一只漂亮的孔雀在开屏。

dagger.s: Take both the saber and the dagger with you, the tropical jungle is really dangerous.
dagger.t: 把军刀和短剑都戴上，热带丛林真的危险。

readily.s: Although Hiroko dislikes cigarette smoke, she readily goes out drinking with friends.
readily.t: 虽然弘子不喜欢香烟的烟雾，她却乐意和朋友出去喝酒。

readily.s: People will accept your idea much more readily if you tell them Benjamin Franklin said it first.
readily.t: 如果你告诉他们富兰克林是第一个这么说的,人们会更乐意接受你的想法。

northwestern.s: "Is this Arabic?" "No, it's Uyghur - a language that's spoken in northwestern China."
northwestern.t: 「这是阿拉伯文吗？」「不是，这是维吾尔文，一种中国西北部的语言。」

appendicitis.s: My brother may have acute appendicitis, in which case he’d have to have an operation.
appendicitis.t: 我弟弟可能得了急性阑尾炎，要是这样他必须做个手术。

irrelevant.s: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
irrelevant.t: 有时候发现自己基本上没有时间顾及一些无关紧要的琐事。

trivia.s: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
trivia.t: 有时候发现自己基本上没有时间顾及一些无关紧要的琐事。

deletion.s: It is highly probable that the deletion of element C will still yield the same result.
deletion.t: 很有可能去掉C元素会得出同样的结果。

optimum.s: The data suggest that the optimum length of a lecture may be 30 instead of 60 minutes.
optimum.t: 数据表明大课的最佳时间是30分钟，而不是60分钟。

gust.s: Losing his balance from a sudden gust of wind, the tightrope walker fell to his death.
gust.t: 突然刮起一阵风，走钢索的人失去了平衡便摔死了。

contradict.s: I cannot forbid a person to marry several wives, for it does not contradict Scripture.
contradict.t: 我不能禁止一个人娶好几个妻子，因为这与圣经不矛盾。

scripture.s: I cannot forbid a person to marry several wives, for it does not contradict Scripture.
scripture.t: 我不能禁止一个人娶好几个妻子，因为这与圣经不矛盾。

alas.s: Many of our pioneers are still alive... but, alas, many of them aren't alive any more.
alas.t: 我们的先驱者中许多还活著...但是，唉，其中有许多已经死了。

persuasion.s: I was born into the Hebrew persuasion, but when I got older I converted to narcissism.
persuasion.t: 我天生具有希伯来人的说服才能，但当我年纪大了的时候，我把它转换成了自恋。

manageable.s: Memorising the cards in a deck in order is certainly a difficult task, but manageable.
manageable.t: 把一叠扑克牌的排列次序背熟，虽然绝不是一件易事，却也不是没有可能的。

pessimism.s: Optimism is like the lamp of hope. Pessimism [or negativity] is like a drug of sorrow.
pessimism.t: 乐观如明灯,照亮希望的前程.消极如毒品,腐蚀健康的心灵.

boxer.s: She likes wearing boxer briefs, she doesn't like briefs, and also doesn't like thongs.
boxer.t: 她喜欢穿平角内裤，不喜欢穿三角的，也不喜欢穿丁字裤。

baseless.s: All of your accusations are baseless. She is innocent, and we are going to prove that.
baseless.t: 你所有的指控都是毫无根据的。她是无辜的，并且我们将证明这一点。

refined.s: The cat glided along, very refined, but ended up falling, which was very embarrassing.
refined.t: 这只猫咪气场全开，走著猫步，相当优雅，然后摔倒了，真是糗大了。

validity.s: You shouldn't deny the validity of everything she did just because of a single mistake.
validity.t: 你不能因为她所犯下的一个错误就否定她所做的一切。

fugitive.s: The fugitive surfaced in a small town fifty miles from here but then disappeared again.
fugitive.t: 那个逃犯在离这里五十英里的小镇上现身过后又消失了。

outwards.s: His body type is born balanced! Wide shoulders, slim waist, belly not popping outwards.
outwards.t: 他的体形生得很匀称！肩膀宽，腰身窄，肚子又没凸出来。

rogue.s: In the late 20th century, Yugoslavia was considered a rogue state by the United States.
rogue.t: 在二十世纪末期，南斯拉夫被美国认为是一个流氓国家。

evasion.s: The accusations are shocking: money laundering, tax evasion and obstruction of justice.
evasion.t: 这些指控令人震惊:洗钱、逃税和妨碍司法公正。

obstruction.s: The accusations are shocking: money laundering, tax evasion and obstruction of justice.
obstruction.t: 这些指控令人震惊:洗钱、逃税和妨碍司法公正。

impure.s: The trouble is not with impure politics, but that the whole game of politics is rotten.
impure.t: 问题不是政治不纯洁，而是整个政治博弈已经腐朽。

proliferation.s: The proliferation of Internet usage has given birth to a new generation of young people.
proliferation.t: 互联网的广泛应用使新一代的年轻人诞生了。

witty.s: She's quick on her feet, so no matter what you say to her, she'll have a witty comeback.
witty.t: 她的脑筋转得很快，无论你对她说些什么，她总能巧妙地作出反驳。

taciturn.s: Jason was a taciturn individual, so it was always a real surprise when he said anything.
taciturn.t: 杰森是一个沉默寡言的人，所以当他说些什么的时候，总是一个真正的惊喜。

displays.s: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
displays.t: 韩国随着朝鲜的外患而在边界附近集结军队。

displays.s: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
displays.t: 当计数器的数值达到预设的「幸运号码」时，就会显示一则恭喜讯息。

aggression.s: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
aggression.t: 韩国随着朝鲜的外患而在边界附近集结军队。

psychiatrist.s: Mahfoud Boucebci was a great Kabyle psychiatrist murdered by Islamist terrorism in 1993.
psychiatrist.t: 马哈福德布塞布奇是伟大的卡拜尔心理医师，于1993年遭伊斯兰恐怖分子谋杀。

repertoire.s: Her repertoire on the piano is not very large, but she has learned every piece by heart.
repertoire.t: 虽然在钢琴上她的造诣不是很深，但是她勤而好学。

frail.s: Mary had become so frail and gaunt that it seemed she already had one foot in the grave.
frail.t: 玛丽变得如此虚弱和憔悴，似乎她的一只脚已经踏进了坟墓。

gaunt.s: Mary had become so frail and gaunt that it seemed she already had one foot in the grave.
gaunt.t: 玛丽变得如此虚弱和憔悴，似乎她的一只脚已经踏进了坟墓。

southwestern.s: I can speak Standard Chinese (Putonghua), Southwestern Mandarin, Wu Chinese, and Spanish.
southwestern.t: 我会普通话、西南官话、吴语和西班牙语。

array.s: Behind every animal on the Chinese zodiac lies an array of proverbs, sayings and stories.
array.t: 每一个生肖的背后都有著数不尽的成语、谚语和故事。

corruption.s: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.
corruption.t: 政治家以揭露政府官员的腐败来推动改革。

egalitarian.s: The lack of gender in English is not due to the English having a more egalitarian culture.
egalitarian.t: 英文中没有阴阳性并不是因为英国人的文化偏向平等。

instinctively.s: Some teachers instinctively know how to play “favorites” to manipulate the other students.
instinctively.t: 有些老师本能地知道怎么去利用“偏心”去控制其他学生。

manipulate.s: Some teachers instinctively know how to play “favorites” to manipulate the other students.
manipulate.t: 有些老师本能地知道怎么去利用“偏心”去控制其他学生。

insurrection.s: A revolution is an insurrection, an act of violence by which one class overthrows another.
insurrection.t: 革命就是一场暴动，一场由一个阶级推翻另一个阶级的暴力行动。

trail.s: The frustrated artist stomped on his failed painting, leaving a trail of shattered colors.
trail.t: 画家失望地践踏失败之作，留下一片混乱的色彩。

customary.s: In Asian culture it's customary to take one's shoes off before entering a house or temple.
customary.t: 在亚洲文化里，习惯在进一个房子或一座寺庙前先脱鞋子。

pregnancy.s: One out of 455 women doesn't realize she's pregnant until the twentieth week of pregnancy.
pregnancy.t: 455名妇女中会有一名直到怀孕第二十周前没有意识到自己怀孕。

wire.s: Having forgotten his key, he was able to open the door by inserting a wire in the keyhole.
wire.t: 他没带钥匙，用铁丝拨动了两下，门居然开了。

keyhole.s: Having forgotten his key, he was able to open the door by inserting a wire in the keyhole.
keyhole.t: 他没带钥匙，用铁丝拨动了两下，门居然开了。

overboard.s: Today may be April Fool's Day, but your prank went overboard. Seriously, I'm pretty angry!
overboard.t: 虽然今天是愚人节，但是你的玩笑开得太过分了，我真的很生气！

brevity.s: When you send a telegram, brevity is essential because you will be charged for every word.
brevity.t: 当我们发电报的时候，简明扼要是关键，因为是以字计费的。

repeatedly.s: I'm tossing and turning, repeatedly thinking about what happened today, deeply remorseful.
repeatedly.t: 我辗转反侧，反复思考着白天发生的事，后悔不已。

repeatedly.s: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
repeatedly.t: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。

remorseful.s: I'm tossing and turning, repeatedly thinking about what happened today, deeply remorseful.
remorseful.t: 我辗转反侧，反复思考着白天发生的事，后悔不已。

invade.s: People shouldn't be allowed to invade countries whose names they can't pronounce correctly.
invade.t: 人们不应该侵犯自己读不正确名字的国家。

hardship.s: He overcame all sorts of hardship and setbacks to succeed in a solo crossing of Antarctica.
hardship.t: 他克服了种种困难和挫折，终于成功一个人越过了南极洲。

collusion.s: The sports world should, at this time, eliminate the collusion with criminal organizations.
collusion.t: 在这个时候，体育世界应当减少犯罪组织的勾结。

venerate.s: Even people who don't believe in the Catholic church venerate the Pope as a symbolic leader.
venerate.t: 甚至是不相信天主教的人也把教皇敬为一个象征性的领导者。

symbolic.s: Even people who don't believe in the Catholic church venerate the Pope as a symbolic leader.
symbolic.t: 甚至是不相信天主教的人也把教皇敬为一个象征性的领导者。

plump.s: When my grandmother was young, her body was very slim. Now in her old age she's grown plump.
plump.t: 我奶奶年轻的时候身材很苗条，现在年纪大了就发福了。

cajole.s: Jimmy tried to cajole his parents into letting him drive across the country with his friends.
cajole.t: 吉米试图说服他父母让他和他的朋友开车跨国旅行。

corporations.s: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
corporations.t: 跨国企业远胜于传统的单一国家企业。

outperform.s: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
outperform.t: 跨国企业远胜于传统的单一国家企业。

imaging.s: A number of imaging techniques are employed in radiology, such as X-ray, MRI, and ultrasound.
imaging.t: 放射学中采用了数种影像技术，比如X光、MRI和超音波。

ambush.s: We've just received intelligence that the enemy is waiting in ambush two miles down the road.
ambush.t: 我们刚刚收到情报，敌方正在前方两英里处埋伏。

abusive.s: The purpose of antitrust law is to stop the abusive influence of the market by big companies.
abusive.t: 反垄断法律的目的是停止滥用市场影响力的大公司.

simplicity.s: The truth and simplicity of nature is always the most important foundation of noteworthy art.
simplicity.t: 大自然的真实和质朴往往是值得注意的艺术中最重要的基石。

noteworthy.s: The truth and simplicity of nature is always the most important foundation of noteworthy art.
noteworthy.t: 大自然的真实和质朴往往是值得注意的艺术中最重要的基石。

arena.s: Tomorrow the Chinese national team play against the Korean national team in their home arena.
arena.t: 明天中国国家队主场对阵韩国国家队。

apostrophe.s: "There's an apostrophe missing. It's and its are different." "I know. It was a typing error."
apostrophe.t: “你漏写了一个撇号。it's和its是有分别的。”“我知道。是我打错了。”

layer.s: I have a dull pain in my temples and my mind feels like its covered with a thin layer of fog.
layer.t: 太阳穴钝钝地痛，意识似乎被笼罩上了一层薄薄的雾霭。

readjust.s: In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
readjust.t: 由于两个竞争对手的一项新协议，我们需要重新调整战略。

strategies.s: In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
strategies.t: 由于两个竞争对手的一项新协议，我们需要重新调整战略。

province.s: The panda is indigenous to Sichuan Province and does not live in the wild in any other places.
province.t: 熊猫在四川省土生土长，不在任何其他省份的野外生活。

province.s: The Fuzhou Zoo in China's Fujian Province has done more than its counterparts in training pandas.
province.t: 中国福建省福州市动物园在训练大熊猫方面做得比它的同行多。

province.s: Taoism was founded on the teachings of Laozi, a sage born in 604 B.C. in present-day Henan Province.
province.t: 道教是用老子的教导创立的，他是公元前六零四年在现代的河南省出生的圣贤。

interpret.s: This moment will nap, you will have a dream; But this moment study,you will interpret a dream.
interpret.t: 此刻打盹，你将做梦；而此刻学习，你将圆梦。

ecological.s: The ecological footprint of a country is closely related to its level of economic development.
ecological.t: 生态印迹与一国的经济发展程度密切相关。

footprint.s: The ecological footprint of a country is closely related to its level of economic development.
footprint.t: 生态印迹与一国的经济发展程度密切相关。

chamber.s: In the most secret chamber of the castle lay the greatest treasure on earth—the Book of Truth.
chamber.t: 在城堡最秘密的密室里有全球宝中之宝——《真理经》。

metric.s: To change the units from metric to imperial and vice versa, the 'menu' button must be clicked.
metric.t: 要把公制单位换算成英制或反过来操作，须点击“菜单”按钮。

versa.s: To change the units from metric to imperial and vice versa, the 'menu' button must be clicked.
versa.t: 要把公制单位换算成英制或反过来操作，须点击“菜单”按钮。

enlightenment.s: Vesak is a Buddhist holiday which celebrates the birth, enlightenment and death of the Buddha.
enlightenment.t: 卫塞节是佛教的一个节日，纪念佛陀的诞生、成道和涅槃。

predators.s: Sturgeons can sometimes live for over 50 years, growing so large that few predators hunt them.
predators.t: 鲟鱼有时长得比一些它的捕食者还大，寿命甚至能超过50年。

hereby.s: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
hereby.t: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。

hostile.s: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
hostile.t: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。

takeover.s: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
takeover.t: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。

swimsuit.s: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
swimsuit.t: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。

isolate.s: Johnson is a recluse; he prefers to isolate himself from the rest of the students in our class.
isolate.t: 约翰逊是个自闭的人；他宁愿把自己孤立于我们班的其他学生。

prosperity.s: Adversity and prosperity reveal one's breadth of mind; joy and anger test one's self-restraint.
prosperity.t: 逆境顺境看襟度，临喜临怒看涵养。

reveal.s: Adversity and prosperity reveal one's breadth of mind; joy and anger test one's self-restraint.
reveal.t: 逆境顺境看襟度，临喜临怒看涵养。

self-restraint.s: Adversity and prosperity reveal one's breadth of mind; joy and anger test one's self-restraint.
self-restraint.t: 逆境顺境看襟度，临喜临怒看涵养。

elliptical.s: Since the orbits are elliptical, the planets do not always have the same distance from the Sun.
elliptical.t: 由于轨道是椭圆形的，行星和太阳之间的距离不会总是相同。

favourable.s: Another factor to be taken into consideration is that the present situation is favourable to us.
favourable.t: 将要考虑的另一个重要因素是，目前的情况对我们有利。

congratulatory.s: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
congratulatory.t: 当计数器的数值达到预设的「幸运号码」时，就会显示一则恭喜讯息。

arc.s: Joan of Arc refused to renounce her belief that the voice she heard was from God and none other.
arc.t: 圣女贞德拒绝放弃相信她听到的声音是来自上帝，而不是其他的。

renounce.s: Joan of Arc refused to renounce her belief that the voice she heard was from God and none other.
renounce.t: 圣女贞德拒绝放弃相信她听到的声音是来自上帝，而不是其他的。

protestant.s: In 1807, Robert Morrison, the first British Protestant missionary to China arrived in Guangzhou.
protestant.t: 一八零七年，第一个到中国的英国新教徒传教士罗伯特马礼逊到了广州。

missionary.s: In 1807, Robert Morrison, the first British Protestant missionary to China arrived in Guangzhou.
missionary.t: 一八零七年，第一个到中国的英国新教徒传教士罗伯特马礼逊到了广州。

artwork.s: In many cases, the image that comes to mind when you listen to music is that of the CD's artwork.
artwork.t: 听歌时脑海里浮起的图像，许多时候都是唱片的封面。

soybean.s: I could eat some beef noodle soup, or some reheated rice with soybean paste like that, no problem.
soybean.t: 我可以不慌不忙吃牛奶面包鸡蛋，或者泡饭酱菜。

petrol.s: More and more environmentalists advocate and use environmentally friendly unleaded petrol in cars.
petrol.t: 越来越多的环保者开始宣传和使用以环保的无铅汽油为燃料的汽车。

disposable.s: In this society where everything is disposable, it is a virtue to use something until it wears out.
disposable.t: 在这个社会里一切都是用完即丢,用东西直到它磨损是一种美德。

handyman.s: The handyman was supposed to arrive at twelve noon, but got stuck in a traffic jam for a few hours.
handyman.t: 这个工人本来应该在中午十二点到达,但他被交通堵塞困住了几个小时。

valiant.s: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.
valiant.t: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。

revolutionary.s: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.
revolutionary.t: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。

proximity.s: The space probe Lucy is expected to arrive in 2025 to the proximity of the asteroid Donaldjohanson.
proximity.t: 太空探测器露西预计将于2025年抵达小行星唐纳德约翰逊附近。

proximity.s: Blind people sometimes develop a compensatory ability to sense the proximity of objects around them.
proximity.t: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。

tolerance.s: By reading books and discussing concepts, a person can gain wisdom and tolerance of differing ideas.
tolerance.t: 借由读书和讨论概念,一个人能获得智慧并包容不同的想法。

baptize.s: The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
baptize.t: 你如果看见圣灵降下，落在谁身上，谁就是用圣灵替人施洗的了。

dismiss.s: By turning the page, we can dismiss the characters in a book without fear of hurting their feelings.
dismiss.t: 书页翻动之间，我们可以对书中的人物不予理会而不伤及他们的情感。

compensatory.s: Blind people sometimes develop a compensatory ability to sense the proximity of objects around them.
compensatory.t: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。

slender.s: Slender and form-fitting with a high cut, the new qipao contrasted sharply with the traditional one.
slender.t: 新的旗袍又修长又紧身，也有短裙摆，与传统式样构成了鲜明的对比。

sage.s: Taoism was founded on the teachings of Laozi, a sage born in 604 B.C. in present-day Henan Province.
sage.t: 道教是用老子的教导创立的，他是公元前六零四年在现代的河南省出生的圣贤。

pickle.s: Did you know that if you plug a pickle into an electrical outlet, it glows and makes buzzing noises?
pickle.t: 你知道如果你把泡菜插入电源插座，它会发光并且发出嗡嗡的声音吗？

overlook.s: Making this matter public would have an effect on our sales, so we're going to overlook it this once.
overlook.t: 公开此事会影响我们的销售，所以我们将忽略它一次。

glorious.s: Therefore, for the glorious God, you must accept each other, and accept Jesus Christ in the same way.
glorious.t: 所以，为了荣耀上帝，你们要彼此接纳，就像基督接纳你们一样。

transformative.s: The telescope has opened a new eye onto the cosmos that has been transformative for our civilization.
transformative.t: 望远镜为我们的文明开启了一种全新的视角来观察宇宙。

harmonize.s: The third point to make is that Emmet attempted to harmonize his theory with the reality of designing.
harmonize.t: 他的第三点说明的是，埃米特试图协调现实与他的理论设计。

nude.s: Do you know how much love it takes for a woman to be undressed by a man, becoming nude in front of him?
nude.t: 你可知道,当女人被男人脱去自己的衣服,一丝不挂的在他面前,需要多少的爱?

detect.s: Instead, they detect sounds through their tongues and feel vibrations through sense organs in the skull.
detect.t: 相反，他们通过舌头来侦测声音，并通过头骨内的感觉器官来感受震动。

surpass.s: If Spenser doesn't keep adding and translating sentences, the other contributors will surely surpass him.
surpass.t: 如果Spenser不继续添加和翻译句子，其他参与者肯定会超过他的。

lessen.s: When you are cheerful, books can increase your happiness; when you are sad, books can lessen your sorrow.
lessen.t: 开心时，书可以给你增加快乐；忧伤时，书可以给你减少哀愁。

batch.s: The third batch of vaccines provided by China to Colombia has arrived in Bogota, the capital of Colombia.
batch.t: 中国向哥伦比亚提供的第三批疫苗运抵哥伦比亚首都波哥大。

constraint.s: There was a feeling of constraint in the room; no one dared to tell the king how foolish his decision was.
constraint.t: 房里有种克制的感觉；没有人敢告诉国王他的决定有多愚蠢。

taboo.s: It exists, but seeing as it is taboo and that nobody talks about it, there's no need to have words for it.
taboo.t: 它的确存在,但是因为人们将它视为禁忌而不去谈论它,也就不需要多说什么了。

nutritional.s: Even though meat is more expensive than fish, the nutritional quality of the two is more or less the same.
nutritional.t: 虽然肉比鱼昂贵，但是两者的营养价值其实是差不多的。

slaughter.s: Many conservationists fear the continuing slaughter of whales is pushing these animals towards extinction.
slaughter.t: 许多自然环境保护主义者担心持续屠杀鲸鱼正推动这些动物走向灭绝。

midsummer.s: The climate of this town is so mild that the thermometer seldom rises to thirty degrees, even in midsummer.
midsummer.t: 这小镇的天气十分暖和，即使是在盛夏，温度计也很少会升到三十度。

saffron.s: The Indian flag is called the tricolour because it has stripes of three colours – saffron, white and green.
saffron.t: 印度国旗叫做「三色旗」，因为它是由三条不同颜色的色条组成的﹣橙黄色、白色和绿色。

induction.s: St James Palace represents her, William and his brother Harry, and now regards her "induction" as complete.
induction.t: 代表她、威廉还有他的弟弟哈利的圣詹姆斯宫现在认为，凯萨琳的“入会时期”已经结束了。

tidal.s: Last year in the Philippines, earthquakes and tidal waves resulted in the deaths of more than 6,000 people.
tidal.t: 菲律宾去年地震和海啸造成了超过6000人的死亡。

packaging.s: We must make the utmost effort to reduce the use of plastic packaging, and also to recycle all waste plastic.
packaging.t: 我们应该尽我们最大的努力减少塑料包装的使用，并回收所有的塑料废物。

recycle.s: We must make the utmost effort to reduce the use of plastic packaging, and also to recycle all waste plastic.
recycle.t: 我们应该尽我们最大的努力减少塑料包装的使用，并回收所有的塑料废物。

gulf.s: Gambling site lets users bet on which species will go extinct because of the oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico.
gulf.t: 赌博网站让用户投注在将灭绝的物种上，因为墨西哥湾漏油。

expend.s: I knew since middle school that only because I was so lonely was I able to expend so much energy on studying.
expend.t: 从中学的时候我就知道，我能够花很多功夫去学习仅仅是因为我过得很寂寞。

retaliate.s: If you're going to say it, you have to say it with force, and take away your opponent's ability to retaliate.
retaliate.t: 要说，就要说得有力量，使对方失去反驳的能力。

icon.s: You have added a comment, not a translation. To add a translation, click on the "あ→а" icon above the sentence.
icon.t: 您已添加了评论，而不是一个翻译。要添加一个翻译，点击这句话上面的«あ→а»图标。

ointment.s: That place's food is great, and their prices are good, but the fly in the ointment is their terrible location.
ointment.t: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。
